 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Theme_-_Young_Seldom;;;There is no track called "Main Theme" from Young Seldom. The rip begins by showing the Walter White / Young Sheldon edit associated with the "Young Sheldon Ending" meme. After this, the rip becomes a parody of the Young Sheldon opening with several changes:  Audio from the "Roblox Chicken Nugget / Gegagedigedagedago" video is mashed up with the instrumental and pitch-shifted to the vocal melody of "Mighty Little Man" by Steve Burns, the show's theme song. The desert location is replaced with the desert commonly used in Gegagedigedagedago videos. Young Sheldon and his family are replaced with a young version of the Roblox Chicken Nugget and several characters from the Gegagedigedagedago series, respectively. The cow is replaced with Charlie, The Steak. The "young sheldon" and "created by Chuck Lorre & Steven Molaro" text is replaced with "young gedagedi" and "created by Geda Gedi & Bakulago", respectively.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Theme_-_Narcis_Crosswords;;;"Main Theme" is not a track in Narcis Crosswords, as the game has no music. At 0:19, the "cat" instrument from Mario Paint is also pitch-shifted and mashed up with "Narcis Dictionary", referencing the meow solo in "Boykisser (song)" by Studi01. At 0:27 and 0:54, "Pomni Song MUSIC VIDEO (The Amazing Digital Circus)" by BENJIxScarlett is also pitch-shifted and mashed up with "Narcis Dictionary". At 0:34, "Gegagedigedagedago (Cotton Eye Joe Viral Version)" by Rednex and Razi is pitch-shifted and mashed up with "Narcis Dictionary".

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Circus_(Mix_Design_Pro)_-_Five_Nights_at_Freddy's;;;At 0:04, the advertised track slows and pitches down, before being cut off by the "What?"  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Pin_Pull_-_YEAH!_YOU_WANT_%22THOSE_GAMES%2C%22_RIGHT%3F_SO_HERE_YOU_GO!_NOW%2C_LET'S_SEE_YOU_CLEAR_THEM!;;;Audio from the "Roblox Chicken Nugget / Gegagedigedagedago" video is pitch-shifted and mashed up with the advertised track. Additionally, the rip shows modified gameplay footage of the advertised game, specifically of Stage 4 of the "Pin Pull" minigame (where the advertised track plays). The player character is replaced with the Roblox Chicken Nugget, the rock has the face of Razi (who sings the original audio of "Roblox Chicken Nugget / Gegagedigedagedago") added, and the moon has the "Baby Incredible" face from "Mr. Incredible Becoming Uncanny" added. Initially, the player pulls the front pin first, resulting in losing the level to the wolf, with large eyes added to the Roblox Chicken Nugget and the audio clips of JonTron saying "What?" from the video "Anti Drug Games" and of Kevin Hart saying "Help me, HELP ME!" from Kevin Hart: Let Me Explain played. A pop-up window then appears with a like symbol, a comment symbol, a countdown (ticking down to the melody of "Human Music"), and text, meant to interpreted collectively as "Like + Comment = Help Roblox Chicken Nuggets?". After the countdown ends, the player clicks on both symbols, followed by the screen changing to white except for a "Retry" button. After the player clicks the button, the level restarts, with the player pulling the top pin, back pin, and front pin, in that order, thus winning the level. At 0:33, the visuals transition to the result screen, with the ROBLOX Man Face added to the entire screen, and "Sexy and I Know It" by LMFAO pitch-shifted and mashed up with "Result" from the advertised game. The player earns two stars, with each star also having the ROBLOX Man Face added. The player then begins exiting the game, with the Minigame Menu showing the other minigames with ROBLOX Man Faces added to their assets. After quitting the game, the visuals show the player watching and liking "Funny monkey peeing in his own mouth EPIC" by funkyhomevideos, as the rip ends.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Jingle_-_Desmond_the_Moon_Bear;;;No elements of the advertised track are present in this rip. The rip plays the "Desmond the Moon Bear" segment from "asdfmovie2" by TomSka with the following changes:  The opening jingle is an arrangement in the instruments and style of "Cotton Eye Joe" by Rednex, with the vocals of "Cotton Eye Joe" pitch-shifted to the jingle's melody. The accompanying caption has been changed from "DESMOND THE MOON BEAR" to "COTTON EYE JOE" to accommodate this. Desmond has been replaced with the Roblox Chicken Nugget, which is in black and white. Instead of saying "How did I get here?", the Roblox Chicken Nugget shouts "WHAT? Help me!" using clips from "Anti Drug Games" by JonTron and Kevin Hart: Let Me Explain, referencing Max Design Pro's Gegagedigedagedago-themed videos.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Theme_-_Five_Nights_at_Freddy's_57:_Freddy_in_Space;;;This rip is a SiIvaGunner-themed parody of "Fnaf has gone woke 🤢🤢👺 #roblox #robloxgames #robloxadoptme #robloxfyp #robloxedit #robloxhorrorgame #robloxstories #robloxhorror #robloxtiktok" by @cleanmeanbeans. The rip's metadata plays off how the TikTok says "the year is 2050, they're making the 35th FNAF game", referencing the same trope as Five Nights at Freddy's 57: Freddy in Space. The rip features a narrator describing how SiIvaGunner is going to be "woke" in its 34th season in 2050 by adding superfluous LGBT elements to several aspects of the channel, mainly characters:  High quality rips are now high quality pronouns. The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 is now the Pronouns-Explainer™. (This humorously subverts the expected "Woke-Explainer" pun.) Grand Dad is now Non-Binary Grandparental Figure. SiIvaGunner now talks about pronouns. When stating this, the narrator at first fumbles with the fact that SiIvaGunner is already based on an icon of homosexuality (specifically Antinous). The narrator also clarifies that this is "worse than that one thing he did" (as the visuals depict SiIvaGunner killing his own creator, a canonical event in the lore as described in "The Creation of GiIvaSunner [FILE-01] - Haltmann's Archives", albeit in this case the creator just inexplicably explodes). This references the original TikTok which has a similar bit stating that reading books to children is worse than killing them. The Voice Inside Your Head is now the Gay Mexican-Ass in My Ass. This line references what Chad Warden called The Voice Inside Your Head during SilvaGunner: Rebooted. John Notwoodman is now John Woodnotman. The narrator audibly chuckles after saying "John WoodNOTman". The narrator says "she's still keeping the mustache, because they're butch", deliberately switching pronouns in reference to the fact that John Notwoodman accepts any pronouns already. Instead of Christmas coming back, "sexy" is coming back (referencing the song "SexyBack" by Justin Timberlake ft. Timbaland). The catchphrase is now "Please read the gender description." If you don't read the gender description, the Pronouns-Explainer™ will explain gender to you, but only after giving a trigger warning and asking for your permission to explain pronouns. This part references the original TikTok, which has a similar bit where the animatronics only kill you after a trigger warning and asking for your boundaries. In the end, the narrator says that they intend to vote for Gay Day in The SiIvaGunner Takeover Do-Over Poll, but then realizes the poll already ended. Several other jokes and callbacks are included in the visuals, such as:  The main building used is modeled off of the "SiivaGunner H.Q." building shown in the rip "Slot Machine (Beta Mix) - Star Fox" with the following changes: A "6-Color Pride" flag banner is placed out in front. The "new memes needed, pls appoint here at 7:00" text is changed to "new PRONOUNS needed, pls appoint here at 7:00". A poster of the John Notwoodman Homosexuality GIF is behind the counter in the lobby, similarly to the bear flag in the original TikTok, next to "6-Color Pride" and transgender pride flags. At 0:12, the drawing for the "Gay Day" option from the SiIvaGunner Takeover Do-Over poll section of "SiIva Direct 6.4.2024" is shown behind The Joke-Explainer™ 7000. At 0:14, the Joke-Explainer's hair is replaced with blue hair, referencing the community post that was made when the SiIvaGunner Bandcamp was removed in April 2024. All future appearances of the Joke-Explainer/Pronouns-Explainer in the video use this hair color as well as the outfit she wore in said community post. At 0:21, a picture is on the wall of SiIvaGunner with a red circle and arrow connecting his face to a photo of a bust of Hadrian, referencing the fact that Antinous was Hadrian's lover. At 0:28, it shows a person saying in Japanese "my statue is complete", followed by the SiIvaGunner statue saying "I only upload high quality video game rips" and then exploding. At 0:41, a tweet from Smoky confirming that John Notwoodman accepts any pronouns in relation to himself is shown. At 0:45, an image of the Joke-Explainer™ 7000 (in her Magolor outfit seen in "Magolor's Shoppe - Team Kirby Clash Deluxe", holding several transgender pride flags, and against another transgender pride flag) is shown in the background. The image at the podium is of John Notwoodman and Nick Lushwood from The SilvaGunner Christmas Comeback Crisis episode "One Last Chance". At 0:48, John Notwoodman says "James Grime". At 0:49, the image "SiIva Stallion" by 601billionlazer from the album The Inevitable Holiday Album, which was originally made for the rip "Field of Hopes and Dreams (PAL Version) - Deltarune", is shown above the conveyor belt. Brawl (Olimar)Danganronpa: Trigger Happy HavocJet Set RadioTHE iDOLM@STERRhythm Heaven At 1:14, the image of The Voice Inside Your Head eating pizza from "One Last Chance" is shown on an Italian flag.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Skimobile_Accident_(Short_Version);;;This begins much like "Skimobile Accident", another spoof of "Snowmobile Accident", a video uploaded on the GilvaSunner channel on December 26, 2011, with "Komm, süsser Tod" starting to fade in at the beginning. However, this time, when the accident occurs, the vocals of "Chimpanzee Riding A Segway" by Parry Gripp are mashed up with "Slider" from Super Mario Galaxy 2, which is melody-swapped with "Chimpanzee Riding A Segway"'s vocal melody, referencing the aforementioned video and the rip "Komm, süsser Tod (Short Version) - Neon Genesis Evangelion 64", which features the same mix name and "Chimpanzee Riding A Segway". The "Slider" melodyswap also begins at the same time as the main "Slider" melody of the original "Snowmobile Accident" video and the video speeds up to match the length of the arrangement in this rip. At 1:25, the video cuts to black to go with the arrangement.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Bonus_Room_Blitz_(Unused_Version)_-_Donkey_Kong_Country;;;This is an arrangement of "Copacabana (At the Copa)" by Barry Manilow using the instruments of the advertised track.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Menu_-_Petz:_Monkeyz_House;;;The melody has been loosely changed to "Tanukichi no Bouken" by MAKOOTO, also known as the background music for Usada Pekora. The inclusion of "Tanukichi no Bouken" during the RANDOM CHIMP EVENT likely references Pekora owning a pet Senegalese bushbaby, which is a part of the primate family.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Store_-_Banana_Kong_2;;;The advertised track is mashed up with "Wannabe" by Spice Girls. At 1:04, a "Munky Cheez" clip from James Rolfe's series "Munky Cheez" is briefly mashed up with the advertised track as the rip ends.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/DK's_Beat_-_Donkey_Kong_Country_Returns_HD;;;No elements of Donkey Kong Country Returns HD are present in this rip, as this rip was published right after the game's reveal trailer premiered during the Nintendo Direct presentation on June 18, 2024.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Theme_-_The_Legend_of_Zelda:_Echoes_of_Wisdom;;;There is no actual known track titled "Main Theme" in The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom, as the rip was released shortly after the game was revealed. Instead, this is an arrangement of "Main Theme" from Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon in the style of the soundtrack of the Switch remake for The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening, referencing the fact that the advertised game and Wand of Gamelon have Zelda as the main playable protagonist. At 2:10, the melody briefly quotes "Raft Ride". In addition, the composer credits are the people who also composed for Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dangerous_Keep_(CD_Version)_-_Magical_Pop'n;;;The melody initially changes alternately to "The Simpsons Main Title Theme" and "GO MY WAY!!". At 0:49, the melody changes to "Family Guy Main Title". The rip loops over at 1:01, then again at 2:02 before fading out. This rip was uploaded on the eighth anniversary of SilvaGunner: Rebooted and uses three of the major jokes from that event. The video description uses the format from the event, with "Composer" and "Platform" being changed to "Composed by" and "Available on" respectively, and the The Joke-Explainer™ 7000's catchphrase being inverted similarly to SiIvaGunner's catchphrase during the reboot. The mix name "CD Version" also alludes to its frequent usage during the reboot.  Fake-out[] Alongside the release of this rip, the avatar was changed to a glitched version of Joke-Explainer's regular avatar, similar to the glitched SiIvaGunner avatar from the reboot, and the channel description was changed to the one used during the reboot, as a fake-out for a potential channel event. The SilvaGunner: Rebooted playlist was also updated to include two private videos. These changes were reverted two hours later with the release of "The Corrupted Alphabet Lore Song - Find The LankyBox Morphs!".  The avatar briefly used after the release of this rip."thumb.png" file of the archive.today archive of the channel on Invidious (which itself is an archive from Wayback Machine).A Wayback Machine archive of the channel on Invidious.

The various squares show various scenes from both the advertised game and Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney including: Edgeworth saying "That autopsy report is outdated, Your Honor." Franziska von Karma whipping Phoenix Wright Edgeworth saying "Thanks to you, I am saddled with unnecessary... feelings." Edgeworth saying "Th-that's impossible!" Wright saying "I believe Mr. Edgeworth sees what I'm getting at." At 0:12, it zooms in on the last square, as Edgeworth says "Phoenix!!!"   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/%22Old_Adam%22_Bar_-_Touhou_16.5:_Violet_Detector;;;At 0:11, "Bramble Blast" from Super Smash Bros. Brawl is mashed up with and arranged to the advertised track. At 0:19, "Trap Queen" is also mashed up with the advertised track, referencing "Bramble Blast - Super Smash Bros. Brawl". At 0:56, "Blammed (Week 4 Update) - Friday Night Funkin'", which references "Bramble Blast - Super Smash Bros. Brawl", is also mashed up with the track. The rip loops at 1:09.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Bubblegum_K.K._(In-Game_Version)_-_Animal_Crossing:_New_Horizons;;;This is an arrangement of "Everybody’s Coming to My House" by David Byrne using the instruments and in the style of the advertised track.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/One-Winged_Angel_(PAL_Version)_-_Final_Fantasy_VII;;;The rip starts off normally until 0:46, where elements from "ANTONYMPH" are pitch-shifted, mashed up with, and arranged to the advertised track.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Credits_-_3D_Dot_Game_Heroes;;;No elements of the advertised track are present. "ANTONYMPH" is pitch-shifted and mashed up with the credits theme. At 0:37, the screen cuts to black in the style of the ending of "Chibi-Robo! Zip Lash | The Darkest Age of Nintendo". At 0:21, a clip of Scott The Woz saying "Hey all!" from "Viral Games" briefly plays, replacing the "yay" from "ANTONYMPH".  At 0:05, the visuals switch to a drawing of Scott The Woz in the style of the single cover art for "ANTONYMPH" with the following details:  It has Scott The Woz at his desk replacing Flutt-GIR-shy Scott has a Wii U playing Animal Crossing: amiibo Festival replacing the laptop The standard Scott The Woz background replaces the original from "ANTONYMPH". Several copies of Madden NFL 08 are visible on the right.      A frame from the rip.   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Deep_Breath_Deep_Breath_-Reincarnation_Reload-_-_Persona_3_Reload;;;The advertised track is mashed up with "ANTONYMPH", with the brass melody changed to "ANTONYMPH" as well.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Shelter_(In-Game_Version)_-_FIFA_17;;;The advertised track is mashed up with "ANTONYMPH". At 2:20, vocal samples from "Shelter" are pitch-shifted and arranged to recreate the Fluttershy samples from "ANTONYMPH". At 2:55, "ANTONYMPH"'s melody changes to "Shelter".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Rainbow_Road_(PAL_Version)_-_Mario_Kart:_Double_Dash!!;;;"ANTONYMPH" is mashed up with and arranged to the advertised track.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Girlfriend's_Song_-_Friday_Night_Funkin';;;The advertised track is mashed up with "ANTONYMPH". Additionally, the rip displays a modded version of the Girlfriend's Song easter egg on the title screen from Friday Night Funkin', with Girlfriend wearing an outfit based on Flutt-GIR-shy's from "ANTONYMPH"'s music video, though with a pair of headphones that bear Boyfriend's color scheme and forbidden logo on the sides, stockings with a color scheme based on Noelle Holiday's fur and hair, and black heels based on Noelle's hooves, the latter two details referencing "Field of Hopes and Dreams (PAL Version) - Deltarune".  Girlfriend on the Title Screen from this rip. 
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/BGM_11_-_Yume_Neko_DS;;;The melody has been changed to "ANTONYMPH", with a "meow" sample from the advertised game replacing the "yay" from "ANTONYMPH".     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Gritzy_Desert_(Beta_Version)_-_Super_Smash_Bros._Brawl;;;The advertised track is mashed up with "ANTONYMPH".     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Positive_Force_(Nintendo_3DS_Version)_-_VVVVVV;;;This is an arrangement of "ANTONYMPH" using the instruments and in the style of the advertised track. At 0:40, a "V" sample stands in for the "Yay!" sample in "ANTONYMPH". At 1:35 and 2:19, the arrangement quotes "Field of Hopes and Dreams" from Deltarune, referencing "Field of Hopes and Dreams (PAL Version) - Deltarune". At 2:16, the "Cool Transition" sample from "ANTONYMPH" is added, followed by a terminal sound from the advertised game standing in for the Skype ringtone. The visuals display a version of the thumbnail featuring the background animation from the game's title screen. Starting at 0:13, the thumbnail switches to the title screen's various colors to the beat of the arrangement, occasionally punctuated by white flashes in sync with percussion hits. At 0:40, the visuals briefly switch to Captain Viridian floating through outer space in sync with the "V" sample. From 1:15 to 1:22, the background fades into the outer space backdrop from the advertised game. At 2:16, the "Gay Pony Transition" from "ANTONYMPH"'s music video is recreated in the advertised game's style. At 2:47, the background disappears in sync with the last beat of the arrangement. At 2:48, the visuals briefly switch to the "sing a song about life" title from the music video of "ANTONYMPH" recreated in the advertised game's font, followed by the advertised game's ending screen. In addition, the mix name likely plays off the lyric "I ain't got no iPhone but I got a DS".     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Beautiful_Girls_(Remix)_-_SingStar_Hottest_Hits;;;While the original "Beautiful Girls" is included on SingStar Hottest Hits, the official remix featuring Fabolous and Lil' Boosie is not. The advertised track is mashed up with "ANTONYMPH".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Wonder_of_Wonder_-_Wonder_of_Wonder_Art;;;The advertised track is mashed up with the instrumental to "ANTONYMPH". Additionally, the visuals display an edited version of the main page for the advertised game, which is linked in the description instead of the playlist link. Hatsune Miku is replaced with Flutt-GIR-shy and the numbers are replaced with Fishstick from Fortnite, referencing the sampling of a cover of "Fishy on Me" by Tiko in "ANTONYMPH", and the sparkling rainbow from "ANTONYMPH"'s official music video with a ">w<" face above it. The illustration is also changed to credit SiIvaGunner.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/A_Song_About_Life_-_Maroon_GO;;;This is a mashup of "Moves Like Jagger" by Maroon 5 ft. Christina Aguilera and "ANTONYMPH" by Vylet Pony. At 0:41, the word "shit" is censored with the "Yay!" sample from "ANTONYMPH". The title references the "SING A SONG ABOUT LIFE" sample prominently featured in numerous Vylet Pony songs.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Waai_WaiWai_WaiWaiWai!_-_Love_Live!_School_idol_festival_2_MIRACLE_LIVE!;;;Elements of the advertised track are mashed up and pitch-shifted to "Hysterical (The World Revolving)" by SharaX. Additionally, the rip displays elaborate animated visuals inspired by the track's official music video, with various jokes referencing both the mashup's joke and SiivaGunner in general:  At the start, the advertised game's logo tilts left and right on the screen, with "Y"s replacing the words "Love Live!" in sync with the lyrics. At 0:10, the thumbnail is blurred out as animations based on the style of the music video of Ruby Kurosawa, Yoshiko Tsushima, and You Watanabe performing Jevil's dance are shown in succession. At 0:18, the visuals switch to a frame of the MIDIJam "mm2wood" video, with the lyrics to the advertised track shown at the bottom of the screen and drawings of Ruby, Yoshiko, and You in Wood Man's style, with Yoshiko playing a recorder and You playing a triangle, moving on the screen. The visuals also occasionally cut to montages of several backgrounds from the Love Live! series, including the "Snow halation" stage. At 0:32, the drawings from 0:10 appear again on a dark cherry blossom background, with each character added to the center first before moving to the side, in the order of Yoshiko, Ruby, and You. At 0:40, the drawing of Yoshiko appears again, this time on an orange background. At 0:42, the moving advertised game logo from the start appears again and continues to replace the words "Love Live!" with the letters spoken in the advertised track. At 0:51, You appears again over the blurred thumbnail, followed by the letters appearing on both sides of the screen. At 0:53, the drawings from 0:10 appear again on a pink background, with both the background and the drawing's subsequent movements across the screen based on a shot from the advertised track's music video. The lyrics of the advertised track also occasionally appear onscreen. At 1:15, the moving advertised game logo from the start appears again, with the words "Love Live!" again replaced with "YYY". At 1:36, the drawings from 0:10 appear again on the background used during Jevil's fight. At 1:47, the moving advertised game logo from the start appears over the visuals, with the words "Love Live!" again replaced with "YYY". At 2:24, the letter "Y" appears on both sides of the screen again, before repeating the sequence from 0:53 with some different lyrics shown. At 2:46, the visuals from 1:36 are replayed. At 2:56, the moving "YYY" logo from 1:47 is shown, before moving offscreen to be replaced by the normal logo. At 3:19, an explosion gif appears as the logo explodes, accompanied by a stock explosion sound before the rip cuts to static.

    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Amalgam_(Singapore_Airlines_Version)_-_Undertale;;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.   At the start, a dialogue box for Sans appears at the bottom of the screen, saying the following as the advertised track plays in the background:  heya. just so that you're aware...this rip might have some flashing lights in itso if that sorta thing isn't your fortei'd get out of here while you still can The words "flashing lights" are additionally changed to cycle through several colors, and Flowey's laugh is also mashed up with the rip. Starting at 0:07, "Se Piscar Já Era" is mashed up with the advertised track, followed by "abc_123_a" and an unknown voice mashed up to the track. After a flash to white at 0:11, the visuals to "Se Piscar Já Era" are shown instead. At 0:21, the visuals change to a screenshot of the True Lab, with Omega Flowey's screen placed in front of it and both displaying the visuals from "Se Piscar Já Era". At 0:42, a transition screen is added with the text saying "TRANSITION (pretend its in undertale font)", after which the visuals change to an Undertale-style fight between a character called "Fuzzio" (based on an uncolored form of the 1993 Alps Color Me Mario plush toy) and the player character (named SORRIZO). The following changes are also made to the fight:  The text of the hovered button changes to ":]". The flavor text at the start says "Fuzzio is here : )". All of the "ACT" options (except for "Check") are changed to ": )". The stats of Fuzzio are "0 ATK 0 DEF", with additional flavor text saying "He's so full of mold. : )", a reference to the "Moldy Mario" meme associated with the Color Me Mario plush. At 0:52, the backflip visual from "Se Piscar Já Era" is overlaid on top of the fight screen and zooms in, transitioning briefly to a dialogue box for a metal pipe (with the "Metal Pipe Falling Sound Effect" playing and the text saying "clang"), before changing the fight to be against Scorpion from Mortal Kombat (specifically the one from the bottom left corner of "Se Piscar Já Era"), except he is later referred to as "SORRIZO RONALDO". The following changes are also made to the fight:  The flavor text says "Your eyes hurt.". The "ACT" options now contain "Smile", "Cry", and "Stare". The stats of SORRIZO RONALDO are "500 FPM", with additional flavor text saying "The peak of YouTube.". SORRIZO RONALDO's dialogue says ": )", with his attacks being grayscale versions of the "Se Piscar Já Era" visuals inside the Bullet Board. At 1:08, the player's SOUL breaks, followed by the visuals to "Montagem - Faz o sample de Guitarra ♪" by vtrlquadra1 being briefly shown and audio from said video mashed up with the advertised track. At 1:09, the visuals to "Se Piscar Já Era" are shown for the remainder of the rip. The mix name refers to Singapore Airlines' inflight entertainment system offering a version of Super Mario Bros. Deluxe and other Game Boy Color games.

Additionally, instead of the thumbnail, the video shows a parody of the cover art of "Not Like Us" using an image from a tweet by @polaqwym, consisting of a top-down image of Grand Glacier from Season 1 of Fortnite Chapter 5 with several player markers added over.      The image used in the rip.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Music_Video_-_Download_2;;;After displaying a single frame from the advertised game where the advertised track plays, the rip becomes a short YTPMV set to the advertised track, with a voice saying "Download 2" at 0:01 and 0:03 pitch-shifted to the advertised track. Various visual jokes are also used, most of which playing off "Download" and "Music Video".  During the transition, Hamood Habibi can be briefly seen in the bottom right corner and moving upwards At the start of the YTPMV, the game logo appears and zooms in, with The numberphile fusion with James Grime / Jay Eazy from "Main Theme (Alternate) - e" also appearing from the bottom left. The following text is shown in the bottom left, based on the old style of music video credits: Kimitaka Matsumae, Suguru Yamaguchi"Music Video"Download 2AlfaSystem Co., Ltd.NEC Avenue, Ltd. Immediately after, the game logo begins spinning away from the viewer, with "The numberphile" moving across the screen. The following download buttons begin appearing on-screen: This image of the iOS "Download on the App Store" badge (top left) A purple download button (top left-middle) This image of a green download button (top right-middle) This image of a red download button (top right) This image of a green download button (center left) This image of an orange download button (center right) This image of a blue download button (bottom left) This image of yellow and black text that says "Download" (bottom right-middle) Another purple download button (bottom right) The download buttons begin zooming out as the "The numberphile" is faintly faded into the background. The visuals zoom in on the game logo, scrolling across then back to the middle, where the "2" from the logo is replaced with the "" from the Undertale 2 logo. At 0:01, the visuals show the Wikipedia article for "Music video" and scrolls through the page. The "The numberphile" also walks down the page, with an audio visualizer added to the top, the game logo added to the top middle, and the following download buttons appearing on-screen: The top right-middle green download button from earlier (top right) A pink version of the aforementioned download button (top left) At 0:02, narration from "e (Euler's Number)" begins playing, with the text shown at the bottom in the "Numberphile" typeface and "The numberphile" animating as well. The audio is abruptly cut off after he says "It's the most important constant".

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dire%2C_Dire_Docks_(Underwater_Cave)_(PAL_Version)_-_Super_Mario_64_DS;;;This is an arrangement of "It's Gonna Be (Alright)" by Ween using the instruments of the advertised track. The rip's inclusion during the SpongeBob SquarePants 25th Anniversary references The Mollusk, the album "It's Gonna Be (Alright)" is from and a major influence on the show's creation.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Snow_halation_(UMI_Mix)_-_Love_Live!_School_Idol_Festival_ALL_STARS;;;The advertised track is mashed up with "(Just a) Simple Sponge" from SpongeBob SquarePants: The Broadway Musical. Additionally, the rip has the standard format for character-dedicated "Snow halation" rips: μ's' stage panning down with animated snow as the featured character, in this case Ethan Slater as SpongeBob SquarePants from SpongeBob SquarePants: The Broadway Musical, appears on the right at 0:12. At 1:38, the background visuals are dimmed, before the background briefly flashes to black at 2:02 and returns to normal at 2:03. At 2:22, the visuals change to a black screen, with the snow added back at 2:26, Ethan Slater added back at 2:28, μ's' stage added back at 2:38, and the background visuals dimmed. At 3:01, the background briefly flashes to black again, followed by the transition of the stage's lights to yellow. At 3:24, the stage pans up, followed by a fade to black. In addition, the mix name likely plays off Umi meaning "sea, ocean".

    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Cocoa_Cave_(US_Version)_-_Kirby_Super_Star;;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.   This is a YTPMV centered around the advertised track, using several visuals related to SpongeBob SquarePants.  At the start, the following visuals are used: Squidward falling off his bike from the episode "Jellyfishing" (top left). “my new steel toed boots :)” by mr. bruh (top middle) Floyd and Lloyd slapping their knees from The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie (top right). An unknown visual of Squidward (bottom middle). At 0:01, the visuals from "Joe Biden Squidward Meme" by CheerioHoles (which uses the scene of Squidward crushed by spike rollers from the episode "Boat Smarts") slowly fade into the center. At 0:05 and 0:17, the "Steppin' on the Beach" scene from the episode "Walking Small" appears in the center. At 0:06 and 0:18, the following visuals are added: The TikTok "When you leave your headphones at home and have to listen to gym music" by @daquan (center). The "victory screech" scene from the episode "The Algae's Always Greener" (left middle and right middle). At 0:23, the Nickelodeon Labor Day weekend version of "Watch Me (Whip/Nae Nae)" appears in the center. At 0:28, the following visuals are added: The deleted Tweet by @lightskinwonderful associated with the "When You're Throwing a Party and a Bunch of Fat Bitches Show Up" meme (which uses an edit of the "No, no, no, no, no! Everyone, get out!" scene from the episode "Ghost Host") (center). The "Preparing the Krabby Patty" scene from the episode "Krusty Krab Training Video", which swaps with the other center visual. Patrick and SpongeBob talking from the episode "Something Smells" (bottom middle, on top of the earlier Squidward scene), the original Sans voice from Undertale. At 0:35, the following visuals are added: The "Electric Zoo" scene from the episode "Krab Borg" (left middle and right middle). This Tumblr post by crimewave420 (center) "Spongebob Me Boy" by Aps17 (center, on top of Tumblr post). At 0:46, the visuals loop back to the ones at 0:28. At 1:03, the visuals return to normal except for the top middle, before abruptly ending.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Morton's_Wood_Door_Hysteria_Hotel_(Variation_1)_-_Hotel_Mario;;;A behind-the-scenes clip found in the Nickelodeon data leak of David J.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Wind_Scene_(Short_Version)_-_Chrono_Trigger;;;Audio from the SpongeBob SquarePants episode "Ghost Host", specifically when SpongeBob says "No, no, no, no, no! Audio from this tweet by @BigNickTheThicc (which also uses visuals from "Ghost Host") is also pitch-shifted and mashed up with the advertised track, briefly switching to "Skibidi Toilet" "Yes Yes" samples at 0:11. Additionally, the visuals display the deleted Tweet by @lightskinwonderful associated with the "When You're Throwing a Party and a Bunch of Fat Bitches Show Up" meme (which uses an edit of the aforementioned scene), with the words "party" and "fat bitches" replaced with images of SpongeBob and the SpongeBob SquarePants logo. The Tweet is initially placed in the center of the screen; at 0:02, the @lightskinwonderful video goes to the left and on the right is the parody of the tweet by @BigNickTheThicc, with the image of SpongeBob flipped over. They are placed in a way where the only letters of the words "Chrono Trigger" spell out "NO", in reference to the joke. At 0:02, this GIF of SpongeBob dancing is placed in the center of the screen. At 0:12, a still of "MWYN SAWS BOBI" from the Welsh dub of the SpongeBob SquarePants episode "The Krusty Sponge", tinted red, briefly appears in the first "O" in "Chrono" before fading away. At 0:24, "Student Finds 'Biggest Chip Ever' || Dogtooth Media" plays sped up as the rip ends.

Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.Missing: Source of the dancing skeleton gif   Weed Mod for Minecraft PC doesn't have a "Main Theme", since the app doesn't have any music. This is a parody of "Minecraft with Gadget" centered around the advertised game, with the following changes:  The Cinemassacre logo is edited to say "MLG massacre" using the Major League Gaming logo. Mike Matei and Inspector Gadget have yellow gamer tags listed above them, with Matei's being "Xx_M1keM8ayy_xX" and Inspector Gadget's being "InspectorSavage420". Inspector Gadget is also edited to wear the "Thug Life" sunglasses and smoke a blunt. Parts of the narration are replaced with audio from several sources, most of which are associated with MLG montages, including: The "Daniel (UK)" text-to-speech voice. The "Oh Hello There" voice clip. Air horns, which additionally arrange the Inspector Gadget theme that plays in the background. "The Next Episode" by Snoop Dogg, specifically the "smoke weed everyday" voice clip. The "Wombo Combo" clip by Lumpycpu. The "Quickscope" sound effect. The "Let's check it out." clip from Vinesauce Joel's reaction to 7 GRAND DAD. The Minecraft app on the iPad is replaced with the advertised game. At 0:41, yellow text is added to the bottom of the screen that says "Get on with it c*nt". At 0:42, when Matei clicks on the app, a hitmarker appears at the spot he clicks, followed by the Major League Gaming logo appearing, and then the thumbnail to “DRUGS IN MINECRAFT ?! Psychedelicraft Mod Showcase - Weed & Cocaine & Hallucinations [ 1.7.2 ]” by JackSucksAtLife is shown. At 0:48, yellow text is added next to Matei that says "wtf?". At 0:54, the original gameplay is replaced with gameplay of the advertised game, with the text "#420" overlaid over the visuals at the beginning of the segment. At 1:31, the gameplay switches to a black screen with text that says "ELIMINATE OTHER PLAYERS", with the Skrillex & Nero remix of "Holdin On" by I SEE MONSTAS playing. At 1:38, the gameplay is overlaid with several guns, which shoot at the iPad and produce more hitmarkers. Additional visuals and sources associated with MLG montages are then added to the rip, including: The "Oh Baby, a Triple!" clip by LustruM. The Eye of Providence. Snoop Dogg from "Drop It Like It's Hot". A clip from "You Just Got Breaded!!!" by casketking00. Several layers of the text "OHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH", accompanied by the audio to "The Rap Battle (PARODY) (ORIGINAL) OHHH!" by SUPAHOTFIRE DESHAWN. Sanic Hegehog. An unknown skeleton animation. Eddy Wally's "Wow". Yellow text that says "#thuglife". The "Damn, Son! Where'd You Find This?" voice clip by Shadoe Haze. At 2:10, when Inspector Gadget prepares to shoot Matei, audio from the "Wombo Combo" clip is played again. When Inspector Gadget shoots Matei later in the scene, the quickscope appears and does the shooting, dealing 420 damage to Matei each time. At 2:17, a Doritos bag replaces the iPad, with the narration changing accordingly to account for this.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Theme_-_Illuminati;;;"Main Theme" is not a track in Illuminati; the rip uses "The X-Files Theme" by Mark Snow, a song often associated with the "Illuminati" meme. The rip is a recreation of satirical "Illuminati Confirmed" videos, with this version centered around The Voice Inside Your Head. The rip begins by playing a clip from The SilvaGunner Christmas Comeback Crisis episode "Loves the Ladies", specifically the scene where Haruka Amami sings "The Noble Haltmann: Final Recital - Kirby Planet Robobot". At 0:14, a record scratch plays as the visuals cut to a black screen. A text-to-speech voice then says "Hold on, did you see that? / Let's play that again.", with the text displayed on-screen. At 0:21, the clip plays again starting from the part where the Voice is eating pizza. At 0:24, the clip pauses, as an Eye of Providence appears in the Voice's right armpit and a version of "The X-Files Theme" (whose melody occasionally changes to "Meet the Flintstones") plays. At 0:33, the black screen returns, with the text-to-speech voice and on-screen text saying "Could The Voice Inside Your Head be Illuminati? / Let's look at another clip.". At 0:40, the rip plays a clip from The SilvaGunner Christmas Comeback Crisis episode "One Last Chance", specifically the scene where Smol Nozomi, Meta Knight, and Santa Claus confront the Voice. At 0:49, the black screen returns, with the text-to-speech voice and on-screen text saying ""Control your fate"? / Like how the Illuminati controls society from the shadows?", and the aforementioned edit of "The X-Files Theme" playing again. At 0:57, several images of the Voice are shown in succession, accompanied by the text-to-speech voice and on-screen text narrating the images:  A frame of the Voice from The SilvaGunner Christmas Comeback Crisis episode "Seasonal Return" ("It's true that The Voice Inside Your Head has been seen in multiple high profile locations...") A frame of the Voice from this Tweet by SiIvaGunner ("...Like the White House") A frame from "Intro - Wood Man's Halloween House Party (ft. David S. Pumpkins)" with the Voice circled in red and a red arrow pointing to him ("... and that Halloween Party!") At 1:10, the black screen returns with the text-to-speech voice and on-screen text saying "Now, I have one last clip to show.". At 1:13, the rip plays a clip from The SilvaGunner Christmas Comeback Crisis episode "Haltmann", specifically the scene where President Haltmann asks the Voice about the progress in getting his daughter back, with additional text briefly added to the visuals to point at Haltmann that says "<-- btw, who is this lol". At 1:24, the black screen returns, with the text-to-speech voice and on-screen text saying "Now, what's actually important here is the office.". At 1:27, a frame from the previous clip is shown and the aforementioned edit of "The X-Files Theme" plays again. At 1:29, the text-to-speech voice and on-screen text say "Notice anything? / There are 44 blue lights inside... / 20 red lights on the buildings outside... / and 8 corners to the desk.". At 1:45, the black screen returns a final time, with the text-to-speech voice and on-screen text using the information from the prior scene to say "(44-20)/8=3". At 1:52, the visuals display a drawing of the Voice alongside an Eye of Providence equating the two, with the text-to-speech voice concluding "The Voice Inside Your Head is Illuminati confirmed.".

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/S3_Act_1_Boss_(OST_Version)_-_Sonic_the_Hedgehog_3_%26_Knuckles;;;This is an arrangement of "INDUSTRY BABY" in the style of the advertised track. At 0:58, the visuals fade into a parody of the "Fans Explaining" Montages / X Slander meme, which often uses "INDUSTRY BABY" as a background song, with the topics being of various parts of Sonic the Hedgehog 3 & Knuckles. At 1:53, the visuals fade back to the thumbnail before the rip fades out.     Time  Text  Visual  Explanation   0:59  knuckles listening to eggman describe his plan (he seems like a trustworthy fellow)  The "Staring Kanye" GIF.  Dr. Eggman lies to Knuckles about who he is and says that Sonic is evil.   1:01  sonic harnessing the power of the winds to make his hitbox slightly bigger  A clip of "Backspin Basketball Flies Off Dam" by Veritasium.  The slander references the Insta-Shield move, which makes Sonic's hitbox slightly bigger after the player jumps, then presses the jump button again while in midair.   1:03  he was forced to beat the marble garden zone act 2 boss as tails  The Crying Seal meme.  The Tails version of the Marble Garden Zone Act 2 boss fight has a reputation for being one of the hardest in the game due to requiring a flying Tails with significant inertia to hit an also flying and quickly-moving Egg Mobile from its bottom.   1:06  angel island zone  A GIF of a sped up skeleton burning with flames surrounding him.  Angel Island ends up burning up due to a brigade of Fire Breaths.   1:08  players when they get the slot machine bonus (they will get triple eggmans)  Clip of from the music video for "Get Your Shine On" by Birdman ft. Lil Wayne of Birdman rubbing his hands together while looking out a window.  Getting three Dr. Eggmans on the slot machine results in the player losing 100 rings.   1:10  trapped in the barrel room trying to move it  The Happy Happy Happy Cat meme.  Carnival Night Zone Act 2 has a single barrel that, unlike the other barrels in the level, requires the player to hit the up and down arrows to move it. The barrel is notorious for getting players stuck, to the point of being known by fans as "The Barrel of Doom", due to requiring the player to figure out its different mechanics.   1:12  kids when they get to ice cap zone (this is the high point of their lives)  The Magikarp Guy meme.  Ice Cap Zone Act 1 begins with Sonic snowboarding.   1:14  the ghost in sandopolis zone act 2  A clip from "SML Movie: Junior The Simp!" by SML.  At full darkness in Sandopolis Zone Act 2, Hyudoros, which are ghosts, swoop down and attack the player.   1:16  "hey who wants to play competition mode"  A clip from The Angry Birds Movie 2 of Red growing up lonely.  Competition Mode is generally less popular among fans due to having smaller sprites, weaker physics, and much simpler and shorter stages in comparison to the default mode.   1:18  every unique blue spheres level  A clip from Toy Story 2 of an aisle full of identical Buzz Lightyear toys.  References the unusually high amount of different levels that are of the Blue Spheres levels as well as how similar they all are to each other.   1:21  the player waiting for hot mobile to kill itself  A clip of Mr. Bean waiting from the movie Mr. Bean's Holiday.  The Hot Mobile cannot be directly attacked, and its boss fight is based on the player simply staying alive until it accidentally destroys itself with its projectiles.   1:23  egg robo to knuckles  The "Throw A Grenade Avori GIF" GIF.  Knuckles' story mode begins with an Egg Robo throwing a bomb at him.   1:25  mecha sonic mark ii fans explaining why an easy boss is actually cool  The "Ibai Llanos Explaining Things" GIF.  Mecha Sonic Mk. II has a fan following as a character despite his boss fight not being especially challenging.   1:27  sega when super emeralds  A clip of Agent J using his neuralyzer from Men in Black.  The Super Emeralds and the Hyper transformation they grant as a reward for collecting them only ever appeared in Sonic the Hedgehog 3 & Knuckles.   1:30  the sonic & knuckles cartridge watching me attach divine sealing to it  The "Willem Dafoe Looking Up" GIF.  Refers to how the Sonic & Knuckles cartridge must be attached with the Sonic 3 cartridge for it to work, with the joking implication being that Divine Sealing, an unlicensed pornographic Genesis/Mega Drive game, would make for an especially strange combination with Sonic & Knuckles.   1:32  groundhog day fans when hedgehog day fans walk in  The "Vince McMahon Surprised" GIF.  Groundhog Day and Hedgehog Day are both observed on February 2nd, the latter being the release date of Sonic 3 back in 1994.   1:34  the player watching big arms kill them as super sonic  The "3D saul goodman" video.  Due to an error, Big Arms is the only boss capable of harming Super Sonic in standalone Sonic 3.   1:36  doomsday zone  This sequence from the Merrie Melodies cartoon "Robin Hood Daffy"  Refers to the high chances of the player hitting the rocks that appear.   1:38  michael jackson when he heard the genesis soundchip  The "Nileseyy Niles Disappearing" GIF.  References Brad Buxer's claim that Michael Jackson ended his involvement in the soundtrack for Sonic 3 after hearing what his compositions sounded like using the Sega Genesis soundchip (which has been denied by Roger Hector).   1:40  vgm composers hearing the sonic 3 act 1 boss music (they will use the samples in their songs)  A clip of the SpongeBob Squarepants episode "The Camping Episode" of Patrick Star is writing down Squidward's actions.  The advertised track uses several external samples that have since gained popularity among modern video game music composers.   1:43  average hydrocity fan  A clip from "itsmefraz episode 7" by Fraz.  "X Slander" videos usually end with a "Average Fan vs. Average Enjoyer" meme. The slanders also reference the popular debate in the Sonic fandom over the pronunciation of "Hydrocity".   1:46  average hydrocity enjoyer  A GIF sequence of the "GigaChad" meme.   1:48  doilus stage  A GIF of the "Doilus Stage" glitch.  Refers to a glitch that occurs when trying to exit the Gumball bonus stage after accessing it from the level select menu, where the "Bonus Stage" title card corrupts into "Doilus Stage" upon reloading the stage, hence the name.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Magolor's_Shoppe_(Short_Version)_-_Team_Kirby_Clash_Deluxe;;;This is a parody of the TikTok video "Why is Donghua Jinlong's Industrial grade glycine of high quality? #dasha  #glycine  #decarbonizers" by gangstasportivik, which is based on the "High Quality Industrial Grade Glycine From Donghua Jinlong" meme. The narration is accompanied by various images:  At the beginning, an image of SiIvaGunner appears. At 0:03, it switches to the standard banner during Season 8. At 0:07, it switches to the "Popular" tab on the channel. At 0:13, it switches to the establishing shot of The Voice's Tower used throughout The SilvaGunner Christmas Comeback Crisis. At 0:18, it switches to a screenshot of the rip "Athletic Theme (PAL Version) - Super Mario World". At 0:21, it switches to the Bandcamp page. At 0:24, it switches to the picture of Studio Gunner from "KFAD Introduction Interview" sans text. At 0:27, it goes to a transition slide with a blue square and the text "follow for more" appearing over. The dialogue is transcribed through captions that mostly mimic the typeface of the aforementioned TikTok video.

    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Take_On_Me_but_it's_in_the_Super_Mario_64_Soundfont_(Music_Video);;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.   The rip begins with, as advertised, an arrangement of "Take On Me" using Super Mario 64 instruments, accompanied by an edit of the music video for "Take On Me", with shots centered on the male lead replaced with original pencil-drawn spoofs featuring Mario and objects from Super Mario 64. At 0:52, the male lead is replaced with a drawing of Brainless Kitty, and farts are pitch-shifted to the arrangement. At 0:53, the arrangement's melody mostly changes to "Pollyanna" from EarthBound Beginnings/MOTHER, likely referencing "Pollyanna - MOTHER 1+2", given the main visual joke of this rip. At 0:56, the Brainless Kitty drawing shakes and turns red, and a wave of Brainless Kitties pours out of the comic book, replacing the extending arm from the original music video. At 1:03, a Brainless Kitty edited to be red and have horns and an evil frown appears in the wave. At 1:05, it appears in front of one of the Mario drawings, which flips horizontally. At 1:08, Brainless Kitties start appearing in front of the faces of extras in the music video, as well as a sign in one of the windows of the diner. At 1:12, a purple Brainless Kitty dances in front of the ceiling fan. At 1:15, the evil Kitty appears in front of a video of a person holding one of the Mario drawings, then panning up to reveal a cat, which then has another Kitty appear in front of its face. At 1:21, the visuals cut to Mario's house from Paper Mario. A clipart newspaper "floats" onto the steps. Several alternating gifs of Silentó then appear in front of the door, as instrumental elements from "Watch Me (Whip/Nae Nae)" are added to the rip. At 1:27, the arrangement's melody changes to "The Muffin Song" by TomSka ft. schmoyoho. Silentó moves to the newspaper, and a MSPaint newspaper appears with a picture of the evil Kitty and the text "EVIL AS SHIT BRAINLESS ON THE LOOSE, RELEASED BY LOCAL DINER-GOER". An exclamation point then appears over Silentó's head, and he slides to the right, then into the door of Candy Mountain from "Charlie the Unicorn" by FilmCow, which has the text on its sign replaced with "EVIL AS SHIT BRAINLESS LAIR CAVE DUNGEON". At 1:40, "Bangarang" is mashed up with and pitch-shifted to the arrangement. At 1:44, Silentó is crudely pasted over gameplay footage of the level "Bowser in the Sky" from the Japanese version of Super Mario 64, as "Watch Me (Whip/Nae Nae)"'s vocals are pitch-shifted to the arrangement. The footage in question is taken from this Super Mario 64 Tool-Assisted Speedrun. At 2:03, the evil Kitty is pasted over Bowser. At 2:24, Silentós dance on the left and right sides of the screen, and the following text in the Paper Mario dialogue font bounces in: "BRAINLESS WAS DEFEATED!!!!!"/"DANCE PARTY!!!!!"; at the same time, the arrangement's melody changes to "Stuck Inside". At 2:28, the percussion from "money machine" by 100 gecs is mashed up with the arrangement as the screen fades to white. It then fades back in to an MSPaint grave at night, with the gravestone reading "R.I.P. Evil Brainless". Dancing by the grave are Silentó, the pixel art Bottom G from "BUTTER FLY - Street Dance", an unknown edit of speedyboyboy's dog Sammi, and a pig from Farmees. At 2:29, "Ooh Nah Nah" is mashed up with the arrangement. At 2:45, "Mega Man" is mashed up with the arrangement. At 2:50, a sped-up Foxy jumpscare from Five Nights at Freddy's 2 plays. Immediately after, The numberphile fusion with James Grime/Jay Eazy first seen in "Main Theme (Alternate) - e" appears in the center. At 2:52, "GRIMACE" by CG5 & DHeusta is mashed up with the arrangement. At 3:03, the arrangement's melody changes to "GRIMACE", as "Be Nice 2 Me" by Bladee is added to the mashup. At 3:21, the Brainless Kitty with an object show mouth from "Pathetic House (Sigma Mix) - Undertale", but tinted green and with happy eyebrows and a Minecraft nametag reading "Nice Brainless" added, bounces in from the right. At 3:26, Nice Brainless "dances" around as farts are again pitch-shifted to the arrangement and the scene has the Windows Movie Maker rainbow filter applied to it. At 3:37, "Breakdance Beach"  by Hail Mary Mallon is added to the mashup, as the melody changes to "Only in Ohio" by CG5. At 4:07, the rip fades out as "Mega Man" is again added to the mashup.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/The_Amazing_Digital_Circus_but_it's_Super_Mario_World;;;The rip begins with the thumbnail image fading in from black, accompanied by "The Amazing Digital Circus Theme" . As the main melody of the track starts to play, the melody and chords change to "Witch Doctor" by David Seville, in reference to the rip "Athletic Theme (PAL Version) - Super Mario World", while the bottom logo is swapped out to read "WITCH DOCTOR" instead of "SUPER MARIO WORLD", and the background above the ground is changed to footage of The Amazing Digital Circus's pilot. At 0:47, the track is mashed up with the Cartoons cover of "Witch Doctor" as in the aforementioned rip. At 0:48, Pomni fades out. At 0:49, elements of "I Show The Meat" are arranged and pitch-shifted to the track, as DaddySpeed from the music video of "I Show The Meat" pops up, with Mario's nose and hat much like Pomni but with a D on the hat. In addition, the background above the ground is replaced by the music video of "I Show The Meat". At 1:06, DaddySpeed is swiftly replaced by Gegagedigedagedago, again with Mario's nose and hat but with a G on the hat, as the Gegagedigedagedago meme audio is pitch-shifted to the track. The background above the ground is replaced with footage of "Gegagedigedagedago (Cotton Eye Joe) Remix" by goldensurfer. At 1:15, Gegagedigedagedago is replaced by Silly Cat, with Mario's nose and hat but with a B on the hat, with the meow sample from Mario Paint's music composer arranged to the track in reference to the meow solo in "Boykisser (song)" by Studi01. The background above the ground is replaced with footage of "Boykisser (song)"'s music video. At 1:22, the Skibidi Toilet swiftly replaces Silly Cat, with Mario's nose and hat but with but the hat's letter being a toilet icon, with the vocals of "Give It To Me x Skibidi Bop Yes Yes Yes" by Fiki & Timbaland mashed up and pitch-shifted to the arrangement. At 1:23, Springtrap from the music video of "Stuck Inside" appears, with Mario's nose and hat but with an S on the hat, as "Stuck Inside" is mashed up with and pitch-shifted to the track. The background above the ground is replaced with the music video for "Stuck Inside". At 1:39, the video fades to white, into the thumbnail edited to include the characters featured in the video (from left to right: Springtrap, Boykisser, Gegagedigedagedago, DaddySpeed, Skibidi Toilet), all with their appropriate edits seen in the rip, with the arrangement returning back to normal. At 1:43, Grand Dad fades in behind DaddySpeed, as the piano instrument used in "Athletic Theme" plays "Meet the Flintstones". At 1:47, the guitar riff from "Buddy Holly" is mashed up with the track, as an edit of the album cover for Weezer (Blue Album) by Weezer with the band members replaced with Pomnis and with the text replaced with "pomni" drops in from the top of the screen. The video contains two end cards, one being a "subscribe" element, and the other being a link to the "Uploads from SiIvaGunner, But Something's Wrong...." playlist.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/One_Winged_Angel_but_with_Classic_Internet_Era_Memes;;;This rip begins as advertised, with three early 2000s memes featured in the thumbnail ("300TMND: THIS IS SPARTA (fun times mix)", "PINGAS!", and "Ievan Polkka") being mashed up with and pitch-shifted to "One-Winged Angel". However, every single other meme featured in the rip besides those three are actually from the late 2010s or later, with most of them being memes used on Grandayy and similar channels. To drive the point home, after 0:13 a spoof of Grandayy's watermark reading "Granddad" is shown in the bottom-left corner.     Time  Joke  Source  Visuals  Notes   0:00-0:03  "300TMND: THIS IS SPARTA (fun times mix)"  keatonkeaton999  A gif of the "This is Sparta!" clip with the caption "SPARTA !!!!!" is shown.   0:03-0:07  "PINGAS!"  Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog, "Boogey-Mania"  The head of the image of Dr. Robotnik from Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog used in "THIS VIDEO CONTAINS WIN" by McMaNGOS is shown, flipping with each note in the song.   0:07-0:13  "Ievan Polkka"  Hatsune Miku  Hachune Miku with a leek from the official PV for "Ievan Polkka" is added above the "VII" in Final Fantasy VII. At 0:12, the samples fade out, and Hachune Miku gradually glitches and fades out.   0:07-0:15  "Darkseid Vs Thanos - Cartoon Beatbox Battles" ("Thanos Beatbox Solo")  verbalase  The video "MORSHU - RTX ON" by Hoolopee, which is associated with said song in the "Morshu Beatbox" meme, is superimposed over the thumbnail.   0:11-0:15  "black kid beeping meme"  N/A  Covers the entire left half of the Final Fantasy VII logo, behind Morshu.   0:15  "2 Phút Hơn (KAIZ Remix)"  Pháo  "［原视频］Zero Two Dance 2560×1080 60FPS" by GhostShadow & Anna Crowe, which is associated with "2 Phút Hơn" in the TikTok meme based on the song, replaces the entire video.   0:26  "Astronomia"  Tony Igy  "Ghana's dancing pallbearers - BBC Africa" by BBC News Africa, which is associated with "Astronomia" in the "Coffin Dance" meme, is shown.   0:33  "Sanctuary Guardian"  EarthBound  "Do the DASH 🏃‍♂️🏃‍♂️🏃‍♂️" by succc.exe, which uses "Sanctuary Guardian", is shown in low quality.     0:37-0:46  "Better Off Alone"  Alice Deejay  The "Otis' Sneaky Dance" scene from Barnyard is shown in the background.  The pairing between the Polish Cow dance and the "Otis' Sneaky Dance" scene references an Instagram post by labrynth.mp4, while the use of "Better Off Alone" originates from the subsequent pamcinema video that popularized the "Otis' Sneaky Dance" meme. Replaces the lyrics for this section aside from "Sephiroth!".   1:18-1:19  "Old Car Horn"  iOS (Apple)  The stock Nerd Emoji video is shown.   1:20-1:34  Vine Boom  Bluezone Corporation  "Singing Killed My Grandma, But Ohio's Got Talent" by BENBROS  During the "Whopper Whopper" section, the footage from "Singing Killed My Grandma, But Ohio's Got Talent" is edited with a nerd emoji on the ground and singalong lyrics for "Whopper Whopper". Several more Vine Booms are present compared to 1:04-1:34, with more clips from "Only in Ohio"'s music video in the visuals.   2:04-2:27  "The Bite of '87 REVEALED!! | Five Nights at Freddy's 4 - Part 5" ("Was that the bite of 87?")"WARNING: YOU WILL DIE | Five Nights at Freddy's 3 - Part 1" ("PURPLE GUY?!") The sound of Fredbear performing the bite of '83.  Five Nights at Freddy's 4  For the bite of '83's sound, Fredbear's biting-the-child sprite animation is shown. For the springlock failure sound, Fredbear's about-to-bite-the-child sprite is shown.  The two sources alternate every beat.   The sound of Purple Guy dying from a springlock failure.  Five Nights at Freddy's 3  For the bite of '83's sound,  this fan gif of Purple Guy imitating the "Oh Yeah Woo Yeah" meme is shown. For the springlock failure sound, Purple Guy's dying-from-the-springlock-failure sprite animation is shown.   2:27-2:49  "Soy Yo"  Bomba Estéreo  The GrubHub "Delivery Dance" commercial is shown, with the visuals initially starting at 2:26 and greenscreened over the Markiplier visuals.   2:43-2:49  "Trap Queen"  Fetty Wap  The samples are accompanied by footage from "Siren Head said hey whats up hello 1738 dance" by chromastone10.   2:50-3:01  "Metal Pipe Falling Sound Effect"  N/A  A stock image of a metal pipe frequently used for the meme is shown.   2:53-3:01  "Dance Mr. Funnybones"  Fleeing the Complex  A GIF of Henry Stickmin doing the Distraction Dance appears in front of the metal pipe stock image. It cuts to match the cuts in "Dance Mr. Funnybones" to match the time signature.   3:01-3:08  "1 2 Buckle My Shoe"  edmondx  The video is superimposed over a flipped version of itself at half opacity. A blurry version of the video fills the background space.   3:09-3:39  "Lose Control"  Missy Elliott ft. Ciara & Fat Man Scoop  The video cuts to a black screen. The Dancing Triforce from The Legend of Zelda: The Light of Courage, which is associated with "Lose Control" in the "Dancing Triangle" meme, appears as a white silhouette while zooming in. At 3:24, the Dancing Triforce is shown in full and stops zooming in. When the beat drops at 3:31, the Dancing Triforce is sped up, and the black background behind it changes to a clip from the Breaking Bad episode "Hermanos" where Gus Fring stands silently in an elevator. Behind Gus, "MORSHU - RTX ON", "［原视频］Zero Two Dance 2560×1080 60FPS", "Ghana's dancing pallbearers - BBC Africa", "Do the DASH 🏃‍♂️🏃‍♂️🏃‍♂️", "Otis' Sneaky Dance", Yone_R6's stickbug video, the "Whopper Whopper" commercial, the Nerd Emoji video, the Dr. Livesy fancam edit, "Only in Ohio"'s music video, the bite of '83 from Five Nights at Freddy's 4, the GrubHub "Delivery Dance" commercial, the metal pipe image, in-game footage from Fleeing the Complex of Henry Stickmin doing the Distraction Dance, "1 2 Buckle My Shoe", and "Siren Head said hey whats up hello 1738 dance" are shown in rapid succession.  At 3:39, the rip loops over from 1:02. It fades to black at 6:30.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Coconut_Mall_But_The_Time_Signature_Keeps_Changing;;;This is an arrangement of "Dancing Mad (Movement 4)" in the style and instruments of "Coconut Mall" from Mario Kart Wii. Playing into what the title advertises, "Dancing Mad (Movement 4)" happens to be a track that constantly switches time signatures (though the thumbnail lists a myriad of time signatures that aren't in "Dancing Mad (Movement 4)", which only uses 4/4, 7/8, and 6/8). At 2:16, an audio clip of Mario saying "Mamaf***er!" from "S.M.B. Bloopers" by SebastianLopez can be heard, standing in for Kefka's laughter in "Dancing Mad (Movement 4)".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Megalovania_but_every_10_seconds_it_plays_a_different_style;;;Unlike what the title says, this is actually a fusion collab style video of "Another Medium", another Undertale track. The rip starts with Undertale gameplay. Frisk enters the Hotland room that displays the outside of the CORE, while the start of "Another Medium" is played using the overdriven guitar from the start of "MEGALOVANIA". As Frisk comes to a stop, the word 'ORIGINAL' in Undertale's logo font fades in. The rip then goes through the order of styles listed in the description, with a related logo replacing the aforementioned Undertale one. Unlike a normal fusion collab, where the segments are timed to the tempo of the song being remixed, the rip sticks to the 10 second timestamps listed in the description, meaning every part abruptly cuts off the previous one in the middle of its phrases.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/VOICELESS_BUT_IM_SCREAMING_THE_LYRICS;;;This rip parodies the "X But Im Screaming The Lyrics" videos by hunter1s1k. As advertised, this rip plays the instrumental of "voiceless". At 0:06, audio of someone coughing can be heard followed by the same person clearing their throat. At 0:15, the rip skips to the 0:29 mark of the original song. Starting from 0:16, the Loud Nigra screams are pitch-shifted to the melody of "voiceless", replacing the song's original vocals. At 1:43, audio of someone sniffing can be heard. Additionally, the visuals show the title card of the original "voiceless" video with captions placed throughout:  "(skipping to the good part)" at 0:04 "lol" at 0:08 "here it comes" at 0:51 "OW" at 1:38 "i was gonna do the rest but my mom came" at 1:49, placed on a completely black background 
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dame_Da_Ne_But_It's_Only_The_Good_Part;;;This fades in at the part of "Baka Mitai" right before the first chorus. At 0:06, "Yankin" is pitch-shifted and arranged to the vocals of "Baka Mitai" with the "sweep" element of "Yankin" arranged to "Baka Mitai" at 0:26. At 0:10 and 0:17, Loud Nigra is pitch-shifted to the instrumental of "Baka Mitai". At 0:36, it cuts to the end of "Baka Mitai". The inclusion of Loud Nigra most likely references the negative reception of “Yankin” rips.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Distraction_Dance_but_It's_Showtime!_(Undertale);;;The rip starts with the advertised arrangement, with the visuals displaying Henry Stickmin doing the Distraction Dance during the first fight against Mettaton in Undertale. At 0:07, the track slowly starts to stop while the visuals slowly turns to black by 0:15. At 0:23, it switches back on, this time switched to an arrangement of "Showtime (Original Mix)" from Homestuck, with the visuals displaying Henry Stickmin doing the Distraction Dance during a fight between John Egbert and his dad from page 90, "[S] STRIFE!". The rip loops at 1:22 and then fade out at 2:08 alongside the visuals turn to black.  Distraction Dance in UndertaleDistraction Dance in Homestuck This rip references "It's Showtime! (Original Mix) - Undertale", a switcheroo which features "Showtime (Original Mix)" unedited.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/%F0%9F%90%BB_%F0%9F%8E%B6_%F0%9F%92%83_The_Bear_Cha-Cha-Cha_but_Something_is_WRONG_and_It_Gets_FASTER_(iPad_recorded);;;In reference to the "iPad recorded" part of the title, several jokes referencing "Minecraft with Gadget" are added. The video start the same way as "The Bear Cha-Cha-Cha but Every Time They Say the Word “Cha” It Gets FASTER (iPad recorded)". At 0:08, the "bear" in "It's time for The Bear Cha-Cha-Cha!" is replaced with "brown bricks". The song at its faster speed is then pitch-shifted to the melody of the Inspector Gadget Theme. After 0:18, Bear starts saying "cha" several times causing the video to get incomprehensibly fast, like in the original video. Starting at 0:21, as the video keeps speeding up, the artwork of Inspector Gadget by Aps17 from the 7th Anniversary Collage fades in. At 0:24, Bear is superimposed with Gadget's head, while he is posing, and a clip of Gadget saying "Minecrap" playing. After that, it switches to a Minecraft screenshot of a player wearing a Bear skin standing inside a recreation of the Bear's house, as "cave1.ogg" sound effect, also from Minecraft, plays, replacing the sound effect used in original video by Daniel the Dino Streaming Guy.  Gadget by Aps17 seen on the 7th Anniversary Collage.A frame from the rip. 
https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Battle!_(Wild_Pokémon)_(2024_Edition)_-_Pokémon_Ruby_%26_Sapphire;;;No joke found.
    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Rules_of_Nature_but_Sephiroth_shows_up_to_the_fight_(Revengeance_Status);;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.   As the title suggests, this is based on the "Revengeance Status" meme. The rip begins by playing "Rules of Nature" from Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance, with parts of the melody changed to "One-Winged Angel" starting at 0:07. At 0:18, the instruments playing "One-Winged Angel" begin to loop, while the rest of "Rules of Nature" plays in the background and occasionally loops as well. At 1:03, the drums from "S.L.A.B. Freestyle" are arranged to the track. At 1:28, the trumpet from "Family Guy Main Title" is pitch-shifted to the track, as a clip of Brian Griffin saying "What the fuck?" from the Family Guy episode "Peter's Two Dads" is played. At 2:02, an unknown song is briefly mashed up with the track. At 2:04, "I Know You Want Me (Calle Ocho)" by Pitbull is mashed up with the track. At 2:07, several voice clips from DJ Khaled are mashed up with the track. At 2:17, the instruments playing "One-Winged Angel" resume, with a clip of DreamyBull mashed up at 2:22 before the rip ends.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Sans._but_it's_damn_daniel;;;The metadata makes it appear to be a reupload of the rip "sans. - Deltarune". However, it is actually a spoof of said rip:  Instead of "sans." itself, it uses an arrangement of "sans." using the instruments of "DURR PLANT Remix" by jerbear. Instead of Josholzz's "Damn Daniel" video, it uses the "DURR PLANT" segment from the I Hate Everything video "I HATE DAMN DANIEL". Instead of the Deltarune thumbnail, it uses the Undertale thumbnail, which changes to read "UNDURRTALE" after the first sample. 
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Mariokart_start_your_engine_but_the_engine_doesnt_start;;;The rip begins as advertised, playing a blue balls edit of "Start Your Engines" alongside a car stalling sound. At 0:22, xonthebeat's producer tag plays, with the rip then arranging "MICROWAVE TYPE BEAT" by xonthebeat using the beeps starting at 0:26. The rip ends abruptly. The thumbnail depicts a watermarked shutterstock image of a car with smoke billowing out of its open hood on the side of what appears to be a UK motorway. Mario is placed in front of it, with his face warped to create a frustrated scowl as Lakitu films him from above. Item boxes are also visible behind the car, and a blurred Spiny Shell is flying towards him from the left.  Luigi can be seen in the opposite carriageway giving the death stare while driving in the wrong direction. Urotsuki from Yume 2kki and a still from this frog gif are further up the road near the oncoming white car. Several tiny Hamood Habibi's are located in the grass on the bottom right of the image. The metal pipe of the "Metal Pipe Falling Sound Effect" meme is placed inside the malfunctioning car's hood.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Super_mario_bros_but_it's_sus;;;This rip is based on the video "Super Mario Bros sus remix (read description,pls)" by Scoose Me, which plays the rip "Underground Theme (Beta Mix) - New Super Mario Bros." and features the "(NEW) SU S" edit used in this rip's thumbnail. The description mimics the one from the video by Scoose Me, replacing SiIvaGunner to Koji Kondo. The rip plays "Underground Theme". At 0:04, the melody is changed to "Hot Cross Buns", and the New Super Mario Bros. thumbnail switches to an edit that reads "(NEW) BUNS.". At 0:14, "Underground Theme" abruptly stops, and it cuts to an edit of the "Boyfriend Uncanny" Discord emoji that is edited to appear as the 5th phase of the "Mr. Incredible Becoming Uncanny" meme, which is displayed for the rest of the rip.      Logo used after melody change.        Another frame from the rip.
