 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Snake_Eater_but_Freddie_Mercury_Sings_It_(AI);;;At 0:12, "Bohemian Rhapsody" by Queen is briefly mashed up with "Snake Eater" from Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater before it is cut off by an outtake of "Somebody To Love" by Queen. At 0:50, "Snake Eater" restarts, but is interrupted again by two outtakes of "Bohemian Rhapsody" put together at 0:59. At 1:09, "Snake Eater" resumes at the first chorus, though is interrupted once again by this outtake of "Bohemian Rhapsody" at 1:13, followed by this outtake of "Bohemian Rhapsody" and an outtake from "We Are The Champions" by Queen at 1:14. "Snake Eater" briefly plays at 1:33, before it gets cut off by a clip from Freddie Mercury's 1985 interview with David Wigg, followed by an outtake from "My Baby Loves Me" by Queen and an outtake from "We Are The Champions" at 2:18. At 2:29, it cuts to silence for the rest of rip. Additionally, the description references the Freddie Mercury quote "Do what you want with my music, just don't make it boring." that is often used in relation to various edits and/or mashups that use music related to him.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Puzzle_Room_but_it's_Chipi_Chipi_Chapa_Chapa;;;This rip does not use "Puzzle Room" at all. Instead, the rip mainly uses "Boss Fight" from Baby Felix Halloween. At the beginning, "Russkij Pusskij" is mashed up with and pitch-shifted to "Boss Fight". At 0:06, "Dubidubidu" by Christell, the song used in the "Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa" meme, is pitch-shifted to "Boss Fight". At 0:33, the song loops over from 0:06. The use of "Russkij Pusskij" and a Felix the Cat-related song references the "Puzzle Room" incident.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Super_Mario_Bros._3_-_Warp_Island_except_it's_in_swing_rhythm!!;;;The rip starts out with the advertised edit of "Warp Island" in swing rhythm. At 0:02, the melody changes to "The Amazing Digital Circus Theme" , while still retaining the swing rhythm. The rip loops over once at 0:19, and again at 0:36 before fading out.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/The_Champs:_Tequila_-_Super_Mario_World_Style_Cover_-_16-Bit_(SiIvaGunner);;;The video is based on the same arrangement from LarryInc64's video. At 0:18 and 2:00, the arrangement's melody changes to "Overworld Theme". At 0:53, the melody returns to "Tequila", but with deliberate inaccuracies from the original: riffs and notes are extended for too long or added where they shouldn't be. At 1:17, the melody briefly changes to "Witch Doctor", referencing "Athletic Theme (PAL Version) - Super Mario World". At 1:23, the melody changes to "Smooth".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Megalovania_but_it's_missing_the_center_channel;;;At 0:20, the rip becomes an arrangement of "Lagtrain" in the style of "Megalovania". Additionally, the rip's visuals change to match the colors of the music video of "Lagtrain". This rip is parodying the channel "That Megalovania Guy", with the thumbnail taken from said channel.  
    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/New_Donk_City_but_every_instrument_is_offsync;;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.Missing: Identify the unknown sound effect   This rip arranges "New Donk City" with the instruments off-sync but with the main melody changed to that of "Astronaut in the Ocean". At 0:37, an AI trumpet voice singing the lyrics of "Astronaut in the Ocean" in its original key is also added. At 2:07, a voice line of Mario being burned by lava from Super Mario 64 followed by an unknown sound can be heard. Additionally, the visuals slowly zoom in on Mario's mouth in the thumbnail as the rip progresses. The use of off-sync "Astronaut in the Ocean" in this rip references this TikTok trend.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Palmtree_Panic_Past_(slowed_%2B_reverb);;;This rip is an arrangement of "Beach Overworld" from New Super Mario Bros. using the instruments of "Palmtree Panic Past" from Sonic CD, with the instruments being slowed down and having more reverb, as advertised. The bottom paragraph of the description is copied from the Wikipedia page for Sonic CD.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/His_Highness'_Memory%3B_2H_but_it's_in_major_key;;;The melody has been changed to the country folk song "You Are My Sunshine". Despite the description, the rip doesn't use any element of Melodyne.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Sand_Canyon_1%2C_but_beats_2_and_4_are_swapped_(Kirby's_Dreamland_3);;;The rip begins by playing the video of the same name by mickeyman713, which is linked in the description. At 0:11, the drums from "Emote: Dance Moves" are added to the rip, with "PS5" by salem ilese, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, and Alan Walker pitch-shifted and mashed up with the rip. At 0:24, "Fortnite Battlepass Freestyle" by Abdul Cisse is pitch-shifted and mashed up with the rip. The rip's jokes loop over once at 0:36, a second time at 1:12, a third time at 1:48, and a fourth time at 2:25 before fading out. (The beat-swapping gradually gets out of sync throughout all these loops due to it being taken directly from mickeyman713's video.)  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/DKL2_Bramble_Blast_but_the_first_note_keeps_repeating;;;In addition to repeating the first note of "Bramble Blast" throughout, the rip arranges "Paper Planes" by M.I.A. at 0:18 and 1:13 and "Trap Queen" by Fetty Wap at 0:55 using the instruments from "Bramble Blast", the latter referencing "Bramble Blast - Super Smash Bros. Brawl".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Lagtrain_but_i_made_it_funnier;;;Instead of any of the memes advertised in the thumbnail, the rip shows a center-mirrored still of Osage-chan from the music video of "Lagtrain", one on each side to make it seem like a conversation between two Osage-chans. Then, the video plays a sentence-mixed dialogue of one telling a knock-knock joke to another, with the words transcribed on screen. It ends with a canned laughter sound effect.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Meme_cat_but_its_singing_the_apple_ringtone;;;The rip plays "Made a Word!", making the word "CAT", with the "iPhone Ringtone Cat" meme video meowing to the aforementioned track's melody. The video ends with the cat being squished by an image of a Alexander McQueen Men's Black Steel Toe Cap Leather Biker Boot and a Thwomp crush sound effect from Mario Kart Wii.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Stuck_Inside_but_it's_slenderman's_verse;;;Rather than a verse based on the actual character of the Slender Man, the rip is based almost entirely on the 20 Dollar Mode featured in the game Slender: The Eight Pages where the song "20 Dollars" by Ron Browz plays whenever Slender Man is nearby. The rip plays an edit of "20 Dollars" by Ron Browz, with its instrumental elements arranged to "Stuck Inside". Additionally, an AI Ron Browz voice performs the lyrics to "Stuck Inside" in the verses and lyrics based on "20 Dollars" (to "Stuck Inside"'s melody) in the choruses. The "Yikes!" sound effect is replaced with the same phrase as heard in the "slenderman cooking hotdogs on the stove" clip from Butchy Kid's "SHOCKING SLENDER MAN VIDEOS" series. For the bridge, the "20 Dollars" instrumental edit is swapped with one of "Pop Champagne" also by Ron Browz, which is mashed up with the original rap verse vocals by Kevin Foster (directly from "Stuck Inside"). The end of the bridge, the white noise from Slender: The Eight Pages is used in place of the high-pitched beep that fades in at the end of the bridge in the original "Stuck Inside". The audio is accompanied by an iMovie slideshow with various found Slender Man artworks. During the choruses, Ron Browz's face is superimposed over Slender Man's head. Additionally, the video features on-screen lyrics, portrayed in stock iMovie text box styles. The rip fades to black at 2:16.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Subwoofer_Lullaby_but_it's_kind_of_sad_and_nostalgic_(%2B_rain);;;As advertised, this rip begins as a slowed-down remix of "Subwoofer Lullaby" from Minecraft with rain ambience. At 0:08, the remix is mashed up with "Song of Raindrops" from Girls' Last Tour. At 0:42, the melody of "Song of Raindrops" is added to "Subwoofer Lullaby".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/City_of_Color_but_it_alternates_between_the_original_and_2023_variants_every_2_beats;;;As advertised, the rip plays an arrangement of "City of Color" that alternates between the Splatoon and Splatoon 3 versions every two beats. At 0:07, the track is mashed up with “no tears left to cry” by Ariana Grande, with it swapping between the first and second verses for each version of "City of Color".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Mario_Dire_Dire_Docks_but_in_Minor_Key;;;The advertised track has been arranged to "Moonlight Sonata (1st Movement)" by Ludwig van Beethoven. Additionally, the rip plays a low-resolution version of "20 Fun ways to kill Super Mario [Death animations] 🤪" by Idan David Animations, with parts of the video played out of order as well.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/T%C3%A1_Rocheda_but_in_the_style_of_Super_Mario_64;;;At 0:24, the melody of the advertised arrangement changes to "Stuck Inside".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Jellyfish_Jam_but_it's_Konga_Conga_Kappa;;;This starts out as advertised, with a mashup of "Konga Conga Kappa (King Conga)"  from Crypt of the NecroDancer and "Stadium Rave A", used in the SpongeBob SquarePants episode "Jellyfish Jam". At 0:15, it switches to a mashup with "Konga Conga Kappa (King Conga)" and "POP TALKING" by Liella!.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/THIS_SONG_IS_BOMB!_Bob-omb_Battlefield_but_PITBULL_REACTS_TO_IT!!!;;;This rip is presented as a reaction video from Pitbull, who "speaks" using sentenced-mixed vocals from various Pitbull songs and media appearances, accompanied by various pictures and GIFs of him. After a brief introduction (where footage of Super Mario 64 and a comment from Shigeru Miyamoto reading "Pitbull you are so $!?#ing real for what you do." are displayed), the reaction properly begins. Key artwork from Super Mario 3D All-Stars is used as a background while Pitbull (edited to appear standing in a hotel room) is usually displayed in the bottom right corner.      The image displayed during most of the rip.   Starting at 0:31, the melody of "Bob-omb Battlefield" is briefly changed to "The Lick" several times throughout the rip until 1:58, where it fades out. Pitbull provides commentary throughout the song, usually causing his reaction portrait to be replaced with a different GIF or image of him. At 1:01, "I Feel Good" by Pitbull ft. Anthony Watts and DJWS is mashed up with the track, with Pitbull edited to say "I feel epic". At 1:14, "Don't Stop the Party" by Pitbull ft. TJR is mashed up with the track. At 1:22, "BESIDE U" by MONSTA X ft. Pitbull is mashed up with the track. At 1:38, "Dame Tu Cosita" by Pitbull, El Chombo, Karol G ft. Cutty Ranks is mashed up with the track. In the reaction video's outro, an edit of the Super Mario 64 logo changed to say "SUPER EPIC" is shown at 1:44, Pitbull edited to wear a clown outfit is shown at 1:46, the "So Retro" Super Mario Bros. GIF is shown at 1:47, and a Mario Pinball Land commercial is shown at 1:50. At 1:59, a 2012 Bud Light commercial featuring Pitbull is played, with a mashup of "Menu" from Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS and Wii U and "C'mon N' Ride It (The Train)" by Quad City DJ's playing over it, referencing the video for "C'Mon and Ride The Smash Hype Train" by BotanicSage which features the same commercial. At 2:04, an instrument is added to "C'Mon and Ride The Smash Hype Train" that plays "The Lick". At 2:07, Mario's head from the start screen of Super Mario 64 appears and says "Here we go!" in sync with Pitbull from the commercial.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Mad_Mew_Mew_(Beta_Version)_-_Undertale;;;The advertised track is mashed up with a fire alarm sound effect.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Bob-Omb_Battlefield_but_in_the_SM64_Soundfont;;;Unlike the original video, which just plays "Bob-omb Battlefield" unedited (since it is a track from Super Mario 64 and thus already uses its soundfont), this rip is a fusion collab style rendition of "Bob-omb Battlefield", where it periodically changes its instrumentation to that of various other music tracks from Super Mario 64.  The thumbnail is the same as the original video, depicting the Super Mario 64 soundtrack boxart with an in-game model of Mario crudely superimposed over the Mario on the cover. However, unlike the original, the background behind him changes to show gameplay footage where each music track style plays in Super Mario 64. The gameplay footage from 0:55 to 1:03 comes from "SM64 - Watch for Rolling Rocks - 0.5x A Presses (Commentated) [OUTDATED]" by pannenkoek2012.    Time  Joke   0:00  "Bob-omb Battlefield"   0:04  "Snow Mountain"   0:12  "Slider"   0:21  "Lethal Lava Land"   0:29  "Koopa's Road"   0:38  "Haunted House"   0:46  "Dire, Dire Docks"   0:55  "Cave Dungeon"   1:03  "Staff Roll"   1:12  Transition into "Course Clear"  The background behind Mario returns to normal at 1:13 and the video fades to black at 1:16.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/I_took_her_to_the_Wii_Shop_but_I_freaked_it;;;The rip begins, as advertised, with a mashup of "Wii Shop Channel" and "King's Dead". The mashup is accompanied by an edit of the music video for "King's Dead", tinted Wii Shop blue and with the following spoof title replacing the real title:   JAY ROCK    KENDRICK LAMAR   FUTURE WII'S DEAD DIR. SIIVAGUNNER AND WII THEME GUY   At 0:02, a "SiIvaGunner" watermark and an audio visualizer with the Wii Shop logo appear with a flash of white, "King's Dead" is mashed up with and pitch-shifted to an arrangement of "Wares - The Way Out (Chester)" from Shovel Knight Pocket Dungeon in the instruments and style of "Wii Shop Channel". The rip fades out at 1:36.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dame_Da_Ne_(Baka_Mitai)_but_I_sing_it_(poorly);;;The video fades into a still of Kazuma Kiryu from Yakuza 0, and plays the advertised song. However, at 0:15, the ripper begins singing "Memories" by Maroon 5, accompanied with on-screen lyrics to "Baka Mitai" at the bottom. At 3:21, the ripper says "Rest in peace Adam Levine. While you may have gotten thirtieth place, you were always number one in our hearts". At 3:56, the rip suddenly changes to a gameplay footage of the karaoke minigame from Yakuza 0, and the singer starts singing "Memories" to the melody of "Baka Mitai". At 4:42, a text reading:   R.I.P Adam Levine "What the fuck do you mean? I'm not dead."  with Adam Levine's KFaD icon appears, as the rip fades out.     A frame from the rip.   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Smart_Race_from_Deltarune_but_I_sing_it;;;The rip begins as advertised, with an acapella cover of "Smart Race" sung over its instrumental. At 0:12, the game over sound from Friday Night Funkin' is played, and "Smart Race"'s instruments are replaced with vocal samples of various Friday Night Funkin' characters, including Boyfriend, Skid and Pump, Mommy Mearest and Senpai. The percussion from "Smart Race" is replaced with samples of the beatboxing from "Fresh" from Friday Night Funkin'.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Sonic_eraser_but_every_GONG_makes_the_song_more_bass_boosted;;;The rip uses "Versus Mode" from Sonic Eraser, with the melody initially changed to "Meet the Flintstones", followed by "Giant Steps" at 0:19.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Watery_Graves_but_it's_in_swing_rhythm;;;As advertised, the rip begins as a swing rhythm arrangement of "Watery Graves". At 0:27, the rip becomes an arrangement of "Finesse" by Bruno Mars using the instruments from "Watery Graves".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Hill_Zone_but_you'll_recognize_it_instantly;;;As advertised, the rip uses "Green Hill Zone". At 0:14, the melody changes to an original composition[citation needed], subverting the promise of the title. The rip fades out at 1:31. The visuals show gameplay of the Sonic the Hedgehog fangame, "After Tokyo Toy Show Build (Hoax)" by NotSoDevy, as stated in the description. It fades along with the audio. The description includes several jokes:  SkdipiToiletGooner references "Skibidi Toilet". NintenDaamnDanie1 references the description of the rip "Title Screen - Super Mario 3D Land" and also likely references the channel of the same spelling. IRideOnRafts references "Raft Ride". Xx_ShengdaBaba_xX references a repeatedly-used placeholder name on albums. 
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Yoshi's_Island_Theme_but_the_long_note_never_ends;;;The rip begins by playing "Flower Garden", with the long note extended slightly. At 0:19, the rip transitions into an arrangement of "Lovely Day" by Bill Withers in the style and instruments of "Flower Garden".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Gnome_forest_pizza_tower_but_its_cursed_woody;;;This rip plays specifically "mmm yes put the tree on my pizza" from Pizza Tower, mashed up with "Cursed Woody Sings a Song" by Aaron Fraser-Nash as advertised. At 0:34, the lyric "I'm coming for you..." is changed to "We're coming for you...". Starting from 0:46, several additional monkey sounds and stock violence and screaming sounds are incorporated into the mashup at the same point where monkey sounds are heard in the original "mmm yes put the tree on my pizza", including a few of Funky Kong's voice clips from Mario Kart Wii and, at 1:06, the Wilhelm scream. In addition, various vocals from "Cursed Woody Sings a Song" are edited arbitrarily, with particular repetition of "Calm down, Woody", "Shut up, Buzz" and "--kill you.", as well as with the sentence-mixed lines "Shut up, Bo" and "Shut the fuck up, Buzz". At 1:17, the mashup abruptly stops, with isolated vocals of Slinky Dog and Woody from "Cursed Woody Sings a Song" saying "Sorry, pal." and "Shut up!", respectively. The rip immediately ends after this. The thumbnail depicts Woody and the "Sings a Song" logo from the thumbnail of "Cursed Woody Sings a Song" on top of the Gnome Forest's title card.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Super_mario_64_but_it's_in_the_buddy_holly_soundfont;;;"Buddy Holly" does not use soundfonts in its instrumentation, and it would be effectively impossible to convert its instrumentation into a soundfont as it uses live instruments (the soundfont mentioned in the video description, The_Ultimate_Buddy_Holly_Soundfont.sf2, is not a real soundfont). This rip is an arrangement of "Bob-omb Battlefield" from Super Mario 64 using instruments and pitch-shifted vocals from "Buddy Holly" that is intentionally designed to sound like a midiswap, using stilted and inauthentic-sounding samples of "Buddy Holly" instruments and sticking closely to the exact notes of "Bob-omb Battlefield" aside from the drums. The arrangement incorporates three melody changes: "Meet the Flintstones" at 1:12, likely a reference to "Bob-omb Battlefield (Short ver.) @ Super MAGFest 2018", "Haunted House" at 2:03, and "Flamingo" by Kero Kero Bonito at 2:20.  
    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Mario_bros._3_Hammer_Bros_Battle_but_its_drip_(NEW_2024);;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.   This is an arrangement of "Hammer Bros. Theme" from Super Mario Bros. 3 that supposed has "drip". At 0:03, an unknown "Oh my god!" clip is mashed up with the arrangement. At 0:06 and 0:44, clips of Neco-Arc are pitch-shifted to the arrangement. At 0:31 and 1:09, "Battle Theme" from New Super Mario Bros. Wii is incorporated as "Boykisser" by Studi01 is pitch-shifted and mashed up with the arrangement. At 1:22, "Elmo Freestyle" by Duwap Kaine is mashed up with the arrangement. The visuals also display an audio visualizer with an image of Raccoon Mario from Super Mario Bros. 3 wearing glasses and a Supreme x The North Face By Any Means Nuptse Jacket in the center, as well as an edited version of the Super Mario Bros. 3 title screen that pastes the Supreme brand logo over "Super".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Craftycorn_Song_from_POPPY_PLAYTIME_but_it's_various_MEMES!;;;"Craftycorn Song" is not a track in Poppy Playtime; it actually refers to "CraftyCorn Song (Poppy Playtime Chapter 3 Deep Sleep)" by BENJIxScarlett. The text on the thumbnail says "CRAFTYCORN?!" and "MEMES?!". The rip starts by playing "CraftyCorn Song (Poppy Playtime Chapter 3 Deep Sleep)". At 0:06, evil eyebrows are added to CraftyCorn on the thumbnail, with the visuals zooming in on CraftyCorn and the rip playing "Kill EVERYBODY" by Skrillex instead. At 0:09, the rip becomes a YTPMV set to "Kill EVERYBODY" in the style of the "SKRILLEX TRIBUTE YTMPV" YTPMV fad. The YTPMV uses various modern memes, especially those that are frequently used by low-effort "X but Y" YouTube videos.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Hill_Zone_but_it's_Chipi_Chipi_Chapa_Chapa_Cat;;;The rip begins, as advertised, with "Green Hill Zone" mashed up with the vocals of "Dubidubidu" by Christell, also known as "Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa". However, at 0:14, after a "meow" sound from Mario Paint plays, the vocals of "Dubidubidu" are replaced with the vocals of "Boykisser (song)" by Studi01, pitch-shifted to the melody of the advertised track. Occasionally, vocal elements from "Dubidubidu" are interlaced into the mashup, and starting from 0:27, the full vocal track is additionally layered on top. The video starts with a low-resolution render of the "Green Hill Zone" stage slowly scrolling from left to right, with the Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat appearing a second later. At 0:14, the visuals change to show the music video of "Boykisser (song)" by Studi01 in the center, along with the Boykisser animation of "Dubidubidu" by Kuowom on the sides. Throughout the video's duration, SiIvaGunner's watermark, written in Impact, is visible in the bottom left corner.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Boykisser_(Silly_Cat)_but_it's_Famous_Video_Game_Music;;;Like "Boykisser, Pomni, & Gegagedigedagedago but it's Famous Console Startups", this rip references the "X but Famous Y" videos by shumeezy, which feature clips of various memes pitch-shifted to various famous sources. Similarly to "Boykisser, Pomni, & Gegagedigedagedago but it's Famous Console Startups", this is a compilation of various obscure video game tracks mashed up with Boykisser-related music. Each segment begins with a clicking sound and the name of the music over an animated starfield, in the style of "X but Famous Y" videos by the YouTuber shumeezy, followed by a YTPMV with the source video. The music titles intentionally do not include the games that they are from, in order to further obscure their origin. The video also features the "SiIvaGunner" watermark from "Boykisser, Pomni, & Gegagedigedagedago but it's Famous Console Startups".  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Bomb-Omb_Battlefield_but_it's_Boykisser_(Boykisser_Battlefield);;;The rip begins by playing "Bob-omb Battlefield" from Super Mario 64, with the visuals changed to gameplay footage of the "Bob-omb Battlefield" stage and the Boykisser replacing Mario as the playable character and in the life counter. After the Boykisser interacts with King Bob-omb, the "Cobson" Soyjak face is overlaid onto King Bob-omb and recolored to match.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Boykisser%2C_Pomni%2C_%26_Gegagedigedagedago_but_it's_Famous_Console_Startups;;;This rip references the "X but Famous Y" videos by shumeezy, which feature clips of various memes, most frequently Gegagedigedagedago, pitch-shifted to various famous sources. Contrary to the video's title and thumbnail, clips of the characters mentioned are pitch-shifted to various obscure (or, in the case of SouljaGame, fictitious) console startup jingles or other game sounds, rather than famous ones. In the case of Boykisser, the "clip" used is the meow sample from Mario Paint's music composer, in reference to "Boykisser (song)" by Studi01. Each segment begins with a clicking sound and the title of the console over an animated starfield, copying the format the aforementioned videos use, followed by a video of the chosen character playing over footage from the console startup with the aforementioned pitch-shifting. The video also features a "SiIvaGunner" watermark based on shumeezy's.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Flintstones_but_it's_in_the_Super_Mario_Bros._Soundfont;;;The video opens with a MIDI swap of "Meet the Flintstones", which, at 0:16, is interrupted by the vocals of the original television version of the aforementioned song, sentence-mixed to recite the entirety of Joel's reaction to 7 GRAND DAD. Additionally, the visuals are changed to a Flintstones-themed spoof of the Mario 7-in-1 menu screen, with the player proceeding to select Mario 7, which features Fred Flintstone dressed in a Mario costume and the Great Gazoo inside the star. After the selection, an arrangement of "Ground Theme" in the style and instruments of the television version of "Meet the Flintstones" plays, as the dialogue continues.A frame from the rip.Another frame from the rip. 
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Right_ear:_The_Bible_(Chinese)_(Grand_Dad_AI_Model)%2C_Left_ear:_Mozart_(2x_speed)_(SM64_Soundfont);;;Most elements present in this rip are not accurate to its title. In this rip, the right audio channel plays the Graham text-to-speech voice from Acapela Box (the same voice used for The Voice Inside Your Head) reading Genesis 1 of the Book of Genesis in poorly translated Spanish, while the left audio channel plays an arrangement of the third movement of Ludwig van Beethoven's "Moonlight Sonata" using instruments from Super Mario RPG, which plays at normal speed. This references the "Right Ear, The Bible (Chinese), Left Ear, Mozart (2x Speed)" meme.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Wii_Theme_but_it's_All_My_Fellas;;;This is an arrangement of "ALL MY FELLAS" using instruments from "Mii Channel" and "Wii Shop Channel", as well as Wii menu sound effects. The male TikTok text-to-speech voice replaces the vocal samples from "ALL MY FELLAS". At 0:12, "Boy’s a liar Pt. 2" by PinkPantheress and Ice Spice is mashed up with the arrangement. At 0:24, the arrangement quotes "Lagtrain". The thumbnail of the video is based on "ALL MY FELLAS !!!" by molotov.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Smurf_Cat_but_it's_Skibidi_Toilet_but_it's_a_dance_party_with_your_favorite_characters_shorts;;;This is an animation of a dance party with various characters set inside Club Penguin's "Dance Contest" minigame. The entire rip is accompanied by the slightly slowed down version of "The Spectre" by Alan Walker from this TikTok by @klubnichka_gd, with its main melody changed to that of "The Swamps (Act 03)" from The Smurfs (NES). The melody then changes to "The Amazing Digital Circus Theme" at 0:38. Brainless Kitty constantly does Minecraft parkour by the DJ booth, and a partially visible green Ocelot XA-21 car from Grand Theft Auto Online is placed at the very right of the background. Smurf Cat / Шайлушай is the first character to dance. The first four characters on the top from left to right are:  Pomni from The Amazing Digital Circus SpongeBob SquarePants The numberphile fusion with James Grime / Jay Eazy from "Main Theme (Alternate) - e". Jake from Subway Surfers After Smurf Cat's turn, a Skibidi Toilet from "skibidi toilet 3" by DaFuq!?Boom gets its turn though a warping transition, with the vocals of "Give It To Me x Skibidi Bop Yes Yes Yes" by  DaFuq!?Boom!, the main theme of the "Skibidi Toilet" series, pitch-shifted over the arrangement. Additionally, various Family Guy clips are overlaid under the dance floor, which play for the remainder of the rip. In the context of the event, the appearance of The numberphile is the joke of the rip, because he is not in the (fictitious) original video.[2] The numberphile only appears a few frames after the video starts, so that he isn't visible on the thumbnail, and the description has no mention of him appearing compared to most other characters that appear.  
    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Jevil's_Theme_but_it's_We_Are_Number_One;;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.Missing: Identify the specific LazyTown episodes, if possible.   The rip begins as an AMV (anime music video) centered around Spamton and Jevil, with the instruments from "The Circus" pitch-shifted and arranged to "Carousel" by Melanie Martinez, audio clips from "We Are Number One" sentence-mixed to sing the lyrics to "Carousel", and a Windows Movie Maker title card that says "Spamton x Jevil AMV Carousel". Starting at 0:05, the visuals change to a slideshow of various edited stills from LazyTown with the Derek Bum/Spamton and Robbie Rotten/Jevil edits from "Spamton's Theme but it's Kitchen Gun".  In the first image, Robbie is shown arguing with Derek Bum, who plugs his ears. The scene is captioned "(arguing)". In the second image, Derek is shown holding the "Kitchen Gun" across his chest. In the third image, Robbie (wearing a jester costume) is shown to be shocked by the previous scene. The scene is captioned "WHAT ARE YOU DOING??". In the fourth image, Derek is shown pointing the "Kitchen Gun" at Robbie (who is offscreen). The scene, as well as Derek's yellow eye, is tinted red. In the fifth image, Robbie is shown blasting off via cannon ball. The scene is initially tinted green before looping through several colors, and is captioned "AAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!!!!!". The original scene is taken from the music video from "We Are Number One". In the sixth image, Robbie is shown to be wincing in pain. A red-tinted overlay is added in the center area of the scene and in roughly the same shape as the cannon ball from the previous scene. In the seventh image, Robbie is shown lying in his chair, distraught. The scene slowly shifts to gray, and is captioned "I still love you.......". 
    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Spamton's_Theme_but_it's_Kitchen_Gun;;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.Missing: Identify the specific LazyTown episodes, if possible.   The rip begins as an AMV (anime music video) centered around Spamton and Jevil, with the instruments from "Spamton" and audio clips from the "Kitchen Gun" Peter Serafinowicz Show sketch pitch-shifted and arranged to "We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together" by Taylor Swift, as well as a Windows Movie Maker title card that says "Spamton x Jevil AMV / Spamton and Jevil are never getting back together...". Starting at 0:05, the visuals change to a slideshow of various scenes from LazyTown, with Derek Bum inserted, recolored and modified to resemble Spamton, referencing "3 BIG SHOTS FROM [KITCHEN GUN]" by Grambam36, and Robbie Rotten modified to resemble Jevil, referencing "THE NUMBER ONE REVOLVING" also by Grambam36, edited in, along with various heart visuals. The last two images in particular reference "Fuck Love Perry" by Colaws.  In the first slide after the title card, an image of Derek princess-carrying Robbie is shown. The scene loops through being tinted the colors of the rainbow, with an outer-traveling heart effect over it. In the second slide, an image of Derek and Robbie having a good time is shown with small hearts floating over it. In the third slide, an image is shown of Robbie using his periscope to look for Derek. The scene is captioned "i wonder what my love is up to...". In the fourth slide, Derek is shown kissing the Kitchen Gun in a short boomerang video loop. During this slide, the scene zooms in on Derek, zooms back out, pans diagonally, quickly flashes the colors of the rainbow, pans through the top half of the scene, and finally spins. In the fifth slide, an image is shown of Robbie (now wearing a jester costume) shocked by the previous scene. The scene is captioned "WHAT?! NOOOOOOOOO!!!!!". In the sixth slide, Derek is shown with a bulge effect on his torso next to the Kitchen Gun in its packaging. The scene is captioned "kitchen gun... the baby's kicking!". In the seventh and final slide, Robbie is shown in a newspaper, which rotates into view. The headline reads "f*** love derek bum! / F*** LOVE!". The image in the newspaper then zooms in to fill the screen, as the rip ends.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Stickerbush_symphony_but_i'm_mr._lonely;;;The rip begins, as advertised, with a mashup of "Stickerbush Symphony" and "Mr. Lonely", accompanied by the animated background of the "Bramble Blast" level from Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest, which fades in from black, referencing "とげとげタルめいろスーパードンキーコング2"" by taia777. At 0:19, "Mr. Lonely" is replaced with "So Fresh (Song Of The Year)" by Soulja Boy, which samples "Mr. Lonely" in its intro. At 0:39, "Stickerbush Symphony" stops and the visual turns black. At 0:40, the visuals become a Windows Movie Maker slideshow of photos of Soulja Boy. At 0:42, instruments from "Stickerbush Symphony" are arranged to "So Fresh (Song Of The Year)"'s instrumental. At 2:30, the visual turns black in sync with the beat stopping in "So Fresh (Song Of The Year)".  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Wario's_Gold_Mine_But_it's_Gucci_Gang;;;The rip starts by playing the advertised mashup, with the visuals from the "Wario's Gold Mine" stage and the music video for "Gucci Gang" interlaced together. At 0:11, Green de la Bean appears from the bottom left, before rapidly moving to the center of the screen and moving frenetically. At the same time, "U Guessed It" by OG Maco plays, followed by "No Words" by Hopsin, with the music video for "No Words" played behind Green de la Bean. He then briefly disappears to display the music video for "No Words", with the visuals deep-fried. At 0:18, the visuals from the "Wario's Gold Mine" stage are added back, also deep-fried, with several copies of Green de la Bean scrolling past on both sides of the screen. At 0:24, Green de la Bean returns to the center, with the music video for "No Words" now shown with a black and white filter. At 0:30, the full Green de la Bean image is shown, before changing back to the visuals from 0:18, except with an additional Green de la Bean in the center and much closer to the screen. At 0:36, the visuals briefly revert back to the music video for "Gucci Gang". At 0:48, "U Guessed It" and "No Words" play again, with the visuals changing to the "Wario's Gold Mine" stage again, except with a green filter and deep fried. At 0:53, the Puppy Monkey Baby from the "Puppy Monkey Baby" Mountain Dew ad briefly appears, followed by a rapid series of deep fried visuals from the music video of "No Words", the "Wario's Gold Mine" stage, the full Green de la Bean image, and Funky Kong's appearance in Mario Kart Wii. The rip then cuts to black, with RWQFSFASXC from Five Nights at Freddy's 2 shuffling from side to side, before it abruptly ends.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Fallen_Down_but_in_Minecraft;;;This rip is a parody of Reddit story reading YouTube Short videos. The entire rip is accompanied by an arrangement of "Song of Healing" from The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask in the style and instrumentation of "Fallen Down". This rip shows Minecraft parkour, with an AI text-to-speech voice reading the Reddit post similarly to Reddit story reading videos, The Reddit post itself is made by a user with the name "JokeExplainer7000", and reads "People of Reddit, What's the Loneliest You've Ever Been?". The rip shows that the post has 4.8k upvotes, 6.9k comments and 511 users who replied to the post. The reply shown in the rip is made by the user "niceguy>:]", presumably Wood Man, as the reply is a story themed after Wood Man's story in the The SilvaGunner Christmas Comeback Crisis and the SiIvaGunner All-Star Nuclear Winter Festival.    To view the post, click "Expand".   "i (male, robot, technically 7, i guess? sounds kinda weird, idk.) have been going through the longest, most painful night of my life. it feels like time has stopped, and i've been stuck in this same night for nearly a decade. i live in grandiose city, and it's christmas eve. christmas is usually a time for cheer, but tonight just isn't that. ever since the voice inside your head has taken over things have been dire, near hopeless. his dictatorship has single handedly ruined what was once a good city. my friends have been suffering, and it feels like my memory gets fuzzy every once in a while, as if i am forgetting someone, or multiple people. whether that's just from me being up for what it feels like eternity, i don't know. i tried to escape it all, even abandoning my best friend, and went somewhere that seemed like a perfect paradise. i had laughs, i had fun adventures, and it was overall very nice >:) ... that was until things changed. for the time i stayed in what i considered my "temporary" new home, a deadly winter struck. i had nobody, i was off on my own, up until i met up with an old friend (female, robot, 7 as well? i actually don't really know, and that also sounds really weird still). we went out into the winter together, and found a shelter. from there we knew what our mission was, and headed out with a temporary 3rd member of our party. after we reached our destination, things got strange, but ultimately i knew what i had to do. now, here i am, on my own yet again. completely in darkness, with my own thoughts. i don't know when i'll return to my home, but when i do, i hope that my best friend will still be willing to accept me. for now, i'm all alone." ―u/niceguy>:]   Wood Man's reply has 11.8k upvotes. Then a reply Woodman's post, by the user "BigChunkyBoi" is shown which reads "Wow, edgelord much?". A reply to the reply is shown, by the user "WoodLover1988" saying "not nice.". The rip then abruptly ends.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Wiiville_City:_Driftveil_City_but_it's_Wii_Theme;;;This is an arrangement of "Driftveil City" in the style and instrumentation of "Wii Shop Channel", with occasional elements of "Mii Channel" and sound effects from the Wii Menu. Additionally, vocals from "Hotline Bling" and "Cha Cha" by D.R.A.M. are pitch-shifted and mashed up with the arrangement, with the main lead melody changing to "Hotline Bling" occasionally, in reference to "Wii Shop Bling" by toonlink. At 1:12, "ESSKEETIT" by Lil Pump is mashed up with the arrangement as the rip fades out.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/What_Redbone_would_sound_like_sung_by_the_Pokemon_Black_soundfont;;;At 0:06, it becomes an arrangement of "Pirate Island" from Baby Felix Halloween instead (still keeping some semblance of the style of "Redbone").  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Beep_Block_Skyway_%5C%5C_Super_Mario_3D_World_%5C%5C_(8D_AUDIO);;;As advertised, the rip plays an arrangement of "Beep Block Skyway" in the supposed "8D audio" style, which involves the audio panning around to the left and right ears throughout, with the arrangement additionally mashed up with "Cha Cha Slide" by DJ Casper.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Unwelcome_School_but_beats_2_and_4_are_missing;;;As advertised, the rip plays an edit of "Unwelcome School" with the 2nd and 4th beats from every bar omitted.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Feel_Good_Inc._(Super_Mario_64_soundfont_cover);;;The rip begins as an arrangement of "Feel Good Inc." by Gorillaz ft. De La Soul using the instruments from Super Mario 64. Starting at 0:02, some of the instruments arrange "Raft Ride" instead.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Butter_Building_but_without_the_melody;;;As advertised, this is an edit of "Butter Building" (specifically the one from Kirby's Adventure) without the melody. Burns!" by Loco Loco. At 0:04, the advertised YTPMV kicks in, with the melody and chords of "It Burns! Burns!  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Holiday-Themed_Mario_Kart_Tracks_but_you're_cozy_by_the_fireplace;;;The rip begins by playing "Frappe Snowland" from Mario Kart 64, with ambient fire-crackling sounds playing in the background and the visuals displaying an animated fireplace and a festive border that says "NOW PLAYING: FRAPPE SNOWLAND - MARIO KART 64" at the bottom left. At 0:07, the melody changes to "Fire Burning" by Sean Kingston. At 0:16, a fire alarm sound is played over the arrangement, with the volume of the alarm and fire crackles increasing as well. Starting at 0:38, the alarm beeps are occasionally arranged to "Fire Burning".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/The_mario_brothers_movie_trailer_but_its_vocoded_to_miss_the_rage;;;This is a parody of a series of videos by Crunchy Vocoder in which various source videos are vocoded to "Miss The Rage". This is actually a YTPMV of the original version of "MARIO BROTHERS MOVIE" set to Mario Judah's cover of "Miss The Rage". At 2:20, a clip from "🍄Meet Zah Marios: Luigi's Sweater Vest🍄 ⭐️Nintendrawer⭐️ 🍁Luigi and Daisy Comic Dub🍁" by Slick Frame is briefly included in the YTPMV. The YTPMV has radial blur and blue filters, referencing the Crunchy Vocoder videos, which similarly have filters applied to the source videos.   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Snif_City_Royal_Hotel_-_Pool_but_beats_2_and_4_are_swapped_(from_Paper_Mario:_The_Origami_King);;;The rip begins by playing the video of the same name by mickeyman713. At 0:10, "Today Is Gonna Be a Great Day" by Bowling for Soup, the theme to Phineas and Ferb is mashed up with the rip. At 2:31, as the rip begins to fade out, the melody briefly changes to "Meet the Flintstones" followed by "Your Best Friend" from Undertale shortly after.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Super_Smash_Bros._Brawl_theme_in_the_Kirby_64_Soundfont;;;As advertised in the description, the rip plays an arrangement of "Online Practice Stage" using the instruments of "Factory Inspection" from Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards. The arrangement is additionally mashed up with "The Race" by Tay-K, which occasionally changes in tempo to match the arrangement. The use of "The Race" references "Online Practice Stage - Super Smash Bros. Brawl", which uses "The Race" as one of its jokes. Additionally, the visuals display an audio visualizer of the rip, with an image of Conductor Kirby featured in Super Star Symphony remixes in the center.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/ATHLETIC_THEME_from_SUPER_MARIO_WORLD_but_it's_a_Piano_Tutorial;;;The video opens with a spoof of Sheet Music Boss' title card, changed to read: SIIVAGUNNER  HIGH QUALITY RIPS  NEW RIPS EVERY DAY  It then changes to the footage of Athletic Theme being played in SeeMusic, a MIDI visualiser program, with a promotional artwork of Mario and Yoshi from Super Mario World in the bottom right corner. However, at 0:18, the melody switches to "Witch Doctor", in reference to the rip "Athletic Theme (PAL Version) - Super Mario World". At 0:56, the MIDI becomes a MP3 to MIDI auditory illusion, with the aforementioned rip's second half converted to a MIDI format (also in a slightly faster tempo).The video's title card. 
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Grape_Garden_but_it's_minor_key;;;The rip begins as the advertised minor key conversion of "Grape Garden" from Kirby's Adventure. At 0:09, the melody changes to "Merry-Go-Round of Life" from Howl's Moving Castle.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Start_Menu_from_Undertale%2C_but_it's_Reese's_Puffs;;;The rip's title and thumbnail are taken from the VvvvvaVvvvvvr rip "Start Menu from Undertale, but it's Reese's Puffs". The rip begins as a remaster of the VvvvvaVvvvvvr rip, playing "Start Menu" from Undertale with "Reese's Puffs Rap" pitch-shifted to the melody instead of being simply mashed up with it. However, the video also immediately begins shaking and playing the teleporting sound from EarthBound. The Puffstale logo gets blurry and fades into the CocoBound logo, but then that logo immediately stretches and morphs to instead read "COCOTALE", with a brown background referencing the chocolate from both Reese's Puffs and Coco Pops.  In the midst of this animation, the rip's audio switches at 0:01 to the 1982 Coco Pops Breakfast Cereal ad by Kellogg's pitch-shifted and arranged to an arrangement of every "Start Menu"/"Menu (Full)" variation from Undertale (played in sequence) using the instruments of "Choose a File" from EarthBound. The rip rests at 0:03, letting the arrangement play out. At 1:01, the rip, including the visuals, fades out.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/One_Winged_Angel_but_it's_only_the_good_parts;;;This rip is a parody of "X but only the good/best part(s)" videos, which trim songs to only play the section(s) the creator perceives as the best. In this case, the rip starts playing "One-Winged Angel", though it does not start from the beginning, instead starting at the 0:54 mark of the original song. At 0:48, it skips to the 2:14 mark of the original song. At 0:14, the rip becomes an arrangement of "One-Winged Angel" using instruments and samples from "Big Time Rush" by Big Time Rush. The vocals of "Big Time Rush" are also mashed up and pitch-shifted to the arrangement. The thumbnail and beginning of the rip display a highly saturated image of Safer∙Sephiroth with glowing white eyes as he appears during his boss fight in Final Fantasy VII. At 0:16, Sephiroth fades out and is replaced with a similarly-edited image of Big Time Rush as they appear on the cover of their album BTR. The rip cuts to black at 1:28.      The image displayed at 0:16.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Bonus_Room_Blitz_but_the_melody_plays_too_early;;;This rip plays "Bonus Room Blitz" from Donkey Kong Country with its melody changed to that of "I'm a Believer" by The Monkees. The melody of "I'm a Believer" is off-key with the rest of "Bonus Room Blitz"; the the first five notes of the melody have the same contour as the first five notes in "Bonus Room Blitz"'s melody, so the rip implements "I'm a Believer"'s melody in the key that makes these notes line up exactly, instead of "Bonus Room Blitz"'s actual key. This effectively means the first second of the rip sounds identical to the advertised edit of "Bonus Room Blitz"'s melody being played early, as the melody of "I'm a Believer" starts earlier than that of "Bonus Room Blitz"'s. The visuals show gameplay footage of the "Winky Bonus!" stage from Donkey Kong Country, with its colors inverting at 0:01 and slowly changing to other colors throughout the video. At 0:36, audio from the "Puppy Monkey Baby" Mountain Dew ad is pitch-shifted and mashed up with the track alongside "#PuppyMonkeyBaby Remix" by Sickick Army and the Puppy Monkey Baby from the aforementioned ad is added to the visuals. The rip immediately begins fading out after this.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dire_Dire_Docks_but_it's_on_a_relaxing_starry_night_free_of_distractions;;;This is an arrangement of "Moonlight" by XXXTentacion using the instruments from "Dire, Dire Docks", as well as the drum samples used in "Moonlight". To match the advertised edit, the arrangement is considerably slower than both original songs. At 1:29, the Super Mario 64 logo gradually glows bright green while various eerie, otherworldly noises are heard. A person says, "Woah. What are you?" A robotic voice responds, "I am an alien, and I am going to abduct you for my alien research and technology." The person replies, "Can't you see I'm in the middle of something?" The alien says "You are coming with me", and the logo rises and disappears into a point of light, as the sounds of a spacecraft soaring off are heard.      A frame from the rip.        Another frame from the rip.   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Road_but_the_2nd_beat_is_removed;;;As advertised, this rip plays "Star Road" from Super Mario World, with the second beat of every measure removed. Starting from 0:07, "Hotline Bling" is mashed up and pitch-shifted to the track, in a manner where the section over where the second beat is also omitted to match the edit.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Wii_Sports_but_you_play_the_game_underwater;;;The rip plays ambient underwater sounds, followed at 0:03 by a muffled (to mimic the advertised underwater effect) clip of "Astronaut in the Ocean" pitch-shifted to "Title Screen" from Wii Sports.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Vibin'_Cat_Vibes_to_the_Home_Depot_Theme_Song_but_it's_Omoriboy;;;The rip begins as a parody of "Cat Vibing to the Home Depot Theme Song" by Mlgsyd, with Brainless Kitty replacing the cat in front of the Home Depot logo as "Let's Do This" plays.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Plok_Beach_but_it's_on_CAT_PIANO!;;;The rip begins as an arrangement of "Beach" using specifically the cat piano from "Why?", with the video for "Why?" shown as well. At 0:25, the rip suddenly switches to an arrangement of "Heads Will Roll" by Yeah Yeah Yeahs, with the visuals slowly zooming out. At 0:32, the rip incorporates elements of the JVH-C remix of "Heads Will Roll", with the cat piano arranging the remix and vocals from the remix added as well. Starting at 0:37, several videos by SML are arranged in the style of YouTube remixes associated with the "Dance Till You're Dead" meme, which uses the aforementioned remix:  "SML Movie: Jeffy's YES Day!" at 0:37, specifically the DanceDanceRevolution scene. The game screen switches to Plok gameplay at 0:49. "SML Short: Jeffy's Bathtime" at 0:49, specifically naked Jeffy, which is overlaid over the previous visuals. "SML Movie: Jeffy's Favorite Song!" at 0:50, specifically the scene of Jeffy dancing to "The Bunny Do!" "SML Movie: Mario the Babysitter!" at 1:03, specifically the scene of Jeffy saying "Why?". The official music video for "Heads Will Roll" is interlaced with the aforementioned video. "SML Movie: Jeffy's Bad Word!" at 1:09, specifically the scene of Jeffy in the cupboard. "SML Movie: Jeffy's Fairy Godparents!" at 1:10, specifically the scene of Jeffy saying "Ow!". "SML Movie: Fat Jeffy" at 1:23, specifically the scene where Jeffy breaks the fourth wall, which is overlaid over the previous visuals. After the clip is played, the previous visuals continue, with "Inward Singing" briefly played. 
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Corridors_of_Time_but_it's_in_3%2F4;;;Starting at 0:09, the rip becomes an arrangement of "Lucid Dreamer" (which is also in 3/4) using the instruments of "Corridors of Time" from Chrono Trigger.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Winds_of_Fjords_(from_ROBLOX)_but_in_the_Major_key_(aka_Happy_Version);;;The rip is mostly a major key conversion of "Winds of Fjords" by minomus as advertised. At 0:42, the melody changes to "Baby". At 2:16, the melody changes to "100 Sunny". This plays off both "Baby" and "100 Sunny" being in major keys.  
    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/The_Simpsons_Theme_in_the_Mario_64_Soundfont;;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.   No elements of "The Simpsons Theme" appear in this rip, despite it being advertised as an arrangement of it. Instead, this is an arrangement of "Annoyed Grunt" by Neil Cicierega using instruments, voicelines, and sound effects from Super Mario 64, as well as other Mario-related sources. The arrangement also features original voice clips referencing the episode "Promo Show" of the webseries Super Mario 64: CLASSIFIED, in the voice of the version of Mario from said episode. Instead of the thumbnail, the rip displays an edit of the cover for Neil Cicierega's Mouth Moods, which features "Annoyed Grunt", with Neil being replaced by Mario, his name replaced with "Nintendo", and with the album title changed to "Mouth Mario".     https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Devil_trigger_(dmc5)_but_only_the_good_part;;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.Missing: Background footage starting at 0:15   The rip consists of a segment of the video "[Full Song/Official Lyrics] Devil Trigger - Nero's battle theme from Devil May Cry 5" by R H (which is linked in the description), specifically the segment between 2:22 and 3:12 which comprises the first chorus. At 0:14, the vocals of "Devil Trigger" are mashed up with the instrumental of "His Name is Pewdiepie" by Roomie, with vocals from the latter occasionally added to the mashup as well. Almost immediately after, the visuals of the original video are modified to either include or reference PewDiePie:  Nero is replaced by a similarly framed shot of PewDiePie, with shading applied to it to match that of Nero in the original video. "Devil Trigger"'s on-screen metadata is replaced as follows: "Devil Trigger" is replaced by "His Name Is Pewdiepie", and "Nero's battle theme from Devil May Cry 5" is replaced by "A lil bonus for you bros :)", referencing PewDiePie's fanbase. "Music: Casey Edwards" and "Performance: Ali Edwards" are replaced by "Music: Roomie" and "Performance: Felix Kjellberg" (PewDiePie's real name) respectively. "©CAPCOM CO. LTD. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED" is replaced by "JOIN THE BRO ARMY TODAY! BROFIST". The "Devil Trigger" single cover art is replaced by that of "His Name is Pewdiepie". "Devil Trigger"'s on-screen lyrics on the bottom part of the screen are displayed in Feast of Flesh BB, a font often used by PewDiePie in his videos, instead of the font used in the original. Additionally, the lyrics to the "His Name is Pewdiepie" vocals are displayed on the upper part in Impact font (whereas in PewDiePie's upload of the song they were displayed on the bottom part). The black background is replaced by footage from several sources, including an unknown edit of a Devil May Cry 5 cutscene with PewDiePie references added to it, the video "HIS NAME IS PEWDIEPIE (Song with PewDiePie samples) - Song Challenge 1 - Roomie" by RoomieOfficial and other videos by PewDiePie. When the mashup ends at 0:51, a snippet of "HARD Vs. EASY - (Fridays With PewDiePie - Part 76) (Trials Contest)" by PewDiePie is played where he screams "MY BABY!!"; as he does this, the text "MA BABEY" appears on the top left corner followed by a lot of exclamation marks that soon extend to cover the entire screen just as the rip ends.      A frame of the rip        Another frame of the rip   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Ballin_but_it's_Dire_Dire_Docks_from_Mario_64_(Mustard_feat._Roddy_Ricch);;;Initially, "Ballin'" is mashed up with "Inside the Castle Walls" from Super Mario 64, with the visuals showing gameplay of Mario preparing to enter the "Dire, Dire Docks" stage. At 0:08, the instruments of "Dire, Dire Docks" are arranged to "Whistle" by Flo Rida, with the visuals changing to images of Josh Hutcherson from the Josh Hutcherson "Whistle" Edit meme. At 0:16, "Ballin'" is mashed up with the arrangement, with the visuals changing to a similar edit that uses this image of Roddy Ricch instead. At 2:17, "When you ask Roddy Ricch what he wants to eat (Ballin)" by is0kenny is mashed up with the arrangement, with the visuals fading into this image of is0kenny edited in the same manner as the prior images. At 2:35, "679" by Fetty Wap ft. Remy Boyz is mashed up with the arrangement, with the visuals fading into this image of Fetty Wap edited in the same manner as the prior images. At 2:44, the visuals change back to the original Josh Hutcherson "Whistle" Edit images before fading to black. The thumbnail also features Mario with the hat and cane of Axel from "Axel in Harlem", referencing the various edits that feature "Ballin'".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Bonetrousle_but_it's_the_first_beat_of_every_measure;;;This is an arrangement of "Haunted House" in the style of the advertised edit of "Bonetrousle".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Mass_Destruction_but_it's_the_DK_Rap;;;The rip begins with just "Mass Destruction", with the visuals initially showing the Persona 3 thumbnail before changing to visuals from "DK Rap" and Donkey Kong 64 at 0:03, setting up the advertised mashup. At 0:20, "Mass Destruction" is mashed up with "Drop Diddy Rap" from the Donkey Kong Country episode "Follow That Coconut" instead of "DK Rap", with the visuals from the aforementioned episode shown as well (though the speed of the video is not scaled correctly with the audio, resulting in it gradually becoming desynced). At 0:52, the visuals cut to the thumbnail, consisting of Donkey Kong from "DK Rap" pointing his Coconut Gun near his head and a front-facing image of Donkey Kong from Donkey Kong Country, with it initially zoomed in on the Donkey Kong 64 Donkey Kong. It then zooms out and the vocals from "DK Rap" are sentence-mixed to say "FUCK THIS!", with a caption of the same phrase appearing in the Donkey Kong franchise logo typeface. The sounds of Donkey Kong shooting the Coconut Gun play, with the visuals switching to a black screen. The very last frame of the rip shows an edit of this image. It consists of an edited image of Donald Trump with the caption "WE HAVE TOO MUCH Dark Hour / SEND THAT SHIT TO Iwatodai NOW!" and gameplay footage of Persona 3, edited such that Junpei says "This is why I voted for Biden, man!" and a player response is changed to "Junpei shut the fuck up.".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/The_key_we've_lost_but_it's_Doin%E2%80%99_Your_Mom;;;As advertised, the rip begins with a mashup of the instrumental of "The key we've lost" and the vocals of "Doin' Your Mom". At 0:02, the vocals abruptly switch to vocals from the rip "Calm 4 (Unused) - Minecraft", a Minecraft spoof of "Doin' Your Mom". At 0:21, the main melody of "The key we've lost" changes to "voiceless", a track inspired by tracks from Xenoblade Chronicles X. Starting at 1:31, the ripper sings a Christmas Comeback Crisis-themed parody of "The key we've lost", referencing the structure of "The key we've lost (with lyrics) - Xenoblade Chronicles X OST".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/The_EarthBound_crowd_sample_(Your_Name_Please%2FLiberty_Bell)_but_it's_continued_by_AI;;;The rip begins by playing the aforementioned crowd sample, with the metadata of "Liberty Bell" and "Your Name Please" shown in an EarthBound-esque menu and the title card for Monty Python's Flying Circus displayed on the left, intended as a standard for comparison with the AI version. At 0:04, the colors of the menu are inverted, and the rip plays what is supposedly the advertised "AI-continued" version of the crowd sample. At 0:07, the crowd sample fades out and an arrangement of "Sherbet Head" by Boards of Canada using an EarthBound instrument that plays alongside the crowd sample in the track "Your Name Please", with a different longer crowd noise played behind it. The recolored Ness in the top-left corner turns around, the menu fades into the background, the "Please name him" text begins to change to a scramble of letters, and the title card morphs into the album cover for The Campfire Headphase by Boards of Canada.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/DK_mountain_but_it's_a_different_version_in_each_ear_(USE_HEADPHONES);;;In the left channel, "The Nutshack Intro" is arranged to and mashed up with the Mario Kart Wii version. In the right channel, the song from the "David S. Pumpkins" Saturday Night Live sketch is arranged to the Mario Kart 8 Deluxe version, accompanied by clips from the sketch. The description includes several inside jokes:  Barney Rubble, nekolvr420, and Shengda Baba all reference repeatedly-used placeholder names on albums. biggreenstache7 references John Notwoodman's username in "hi utub im back (Bonus Reveal) - SiIvaGunner: King for Another Day Tournament". Charles "Chuck" Tamzarian is the name of a The Simpsons character, and specifically references the "Sneed's Feed and Seed" meme. FrontierJustice6000 references a SiIvaGunner contributor. HotCrossBunsFan27 references "Hot Cross Buns". NintenDaamDanie1 references the description of the rip "Title Screen - Super Mario 3D Land". nutshackwoodman34 references the SiIvaGunner character of the same name. ScottHatesBreathoftheWild references Scott the Woz's YouTube channel of the same name. 
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/SM64_Slider_but_every_other_beat_is_the_SMG2_version;;;This is an arrangement of the Futurama theme song using the instruments of "Slider", swapping between the two versions every other beat as advertised.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Busta_rhymes_but_he_goes_to_the_Wii_Shop_channel_(2024);;;This is a parody of "Busta Rhymes Goes To The Wii Shop Channel" by DatManOvaDer, which is a mashup of "Look at Me Now" by Chris Brown ft. Busta Rhymes and Lil Wayne and "Let's Shop" by glue70, a remix of "Wii Shop Channel". The rip begins similarly to the original mashup, but at 0:06, "Look at Me Now" is mashed up with and pitch-shifted to an arrangement of "Yo, Go Crazy!" from Shantae and the Pirate's Curse in the instruments and style of "Let's Shop".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Baldi's_Basics_but_it's_a_Jersey_Club_Remix;;;This is a remix of specifically "Everybody's Favorite Subject" from Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning. It starts with the unedited track, which then increases in tempo and pitch to transition to the remix proper. At 0:07, it becomes a "jersey club"-style remix of an "Everybody's Favorite Subject"-style arrangement of "Stuck Inside". The remix also utilizes voice lines and the slap ruler sound effect from Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Player_Down_from_SMW_continued_by_AI;;;The rip parodies the presentation format of videos by KobiMusic. Initially, the rip plays "Player Down" in its entirety, ostensibly as a standard for comparison with the AI version, accompanied by a screenshot of Super Mario World's title screen and the text "(Not AI)". At 0:03, the rip plays what is supposedly the advertised "AI-continued" version of "Player Down", but is actually an edit of "Player Down" that transitions into an arrangement of "Flight of the Bumblebee" by Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov using the instruments of "Player Down". The edit is accompanied by an edit of the screenshot with inverted colors and a warping filter, and by the text "(AI)". At 1:00, the rip suddenly cuts to a black screen with the text "AI Crashed :(", as "Player Down" is played again.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Corneria_but_it_sounds_straight_out_from_a_2009_Roblox_song;;;This rip is based on the rip "Corneria - Super Smash Bros. Melee", which is itself based on "Respect Your Elders" by Chillindude, a rap that heavily samples "Corneria". Instances of "Corneria" in said rip are swapped out for the advertised arrangement of "Corneria" using instruments from a ROBLOX soundfont. The pitch-shifted "Mega Man" clips from the aforementioned rip are kept as-is (just with slightly different mixing). "Respect Your Elders" by JayEazy is initially swapped out for "ROBLOX EN 1 MINUTO RAP" by Zarcort. At 1:29, "Respect Your Elders" by JayEazy is added on top of "ROBLOX EN 1 MINUTO RAP". The description is loosely adapted from "BIG SHOT but it's sounds like straight out from a 2009 old Roblox song" by DownFrown. It also references the ripper of GilvaSunner's uploads of Super Mario 3D Land's soundtrack, NintenDaan1.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Weezer_-_Buddy_Holly_but_it's_Default_Dance;;;The rip plays "Emote: Dance Moves" with its melody changed to the lick from "Buddy Holly". Then, at 0:03, the rip becomes an arrangement of "FORTNITE SONG!!!" in the style and instrumentation of "Buddy Holly", including pitch-shifted vocals of "Buddy Holly". During this arrangement, a few vocal tracks snipped down to a single lyric play in succession at a very low volume.    Time  Lyric  Source   0:10  "You"  "Crank That"   0:12  "What"  "X Gon' Give It To Ya"   0:14  "Aw man"  "Revenge"   0:16  "Soulja Boy tell 'em"  "Crank That"   0:20  [Saxophone riff]  "Who Can It Be Now?" by Men At Work  The combination of these 4 sources is a reference to "Victory! TheGuy - The Bootleg King For Another Day Tournament" by TheGuy. Finally, at 0:24, the original vocals from "FORTNITE SONG!!!" are layered on top of the rip as the arrangement concludes itself. This video is a reference to the YouTube channel @buddyholly1337, which does similar song edits, featuring "Buddy Holly".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Wii_Sports_theme_but_it's_big_ben's_last_chime;;;This is based off and heavily references "Big Ben - Wii Sports" by i-win. Typical of most Big Ben's Final Chimes memes, it begins with the BBC News clip unedited to juxtapose the narrator's commentary with what happens next. This continues until 0:34, where it then becomes the advertised YTPMV, with the chimes pitch-shifted and arranged to "Title Screen" as the visuals flip to go along. At 0:38, it abruptly switches to an arrangement of "Raft Ride" using "Title Screen" and the chimes, as the visuals switch to the "Raft Ride" minigame with a face of Big Ben composted on top of Link and the raft. At 0:47, it switches back to the BBC News live broadcast with the visuals shaking. At 0:55, it fades into an edit of the London skyline with the sky replaced with a white background along with the text "THE LEGEND OF/Wii Sports/BIG BEN'S AWAKENING" in the style of the Wii Sports logo, referencing The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening. At 0:55, the arrangement loops, with additional notes added during the opening as well as different "Raft Ride" minigame footage used. At 1:26, the arrangement instead plays "Hot Cross Buns" as it fades out, with the visuals switching to "VMM Recorder Song 1: Hot Cross Buns" by Visual Musical Minds and a Big Ben face clock moving to the notes. The lyrics are also changed to "Hot Cross Bens". The description is mostly copied from "Big Ben - Wii Sports". The social media links are replaced with hashtags.   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Literally_just_space_jam_but_it_sounds_like_farts;;;The rip's title and thumbnail are taken from the VvvvvaVvvvvvr rip "Literally just space jam but it sounds like farts". The rip plays the music video for "Space Jam", but the vocals are arranged using a stock fart noise commonly accompanied by an image of the Brainless Kitty that appears and flips to the beat. At 0:14, the instrumental of "Space Jam" comes in. Starting at 0:22, the fart noise is pitch-shifted to the melody of "Around the World (La La La La La)" by A Touch of Class. At 0:50, the hamster from this video by sugar20161215 appears in the top left corner flipping to the beat of the backing track of "Around the World (La La La La La)", which is also played using another stock fart noise. At 1:04, the first fart noise plays part of "Gadget Room", with this image of the dog from this video by speedyboyboy shown alongside the cat and the hamster, before the rip ends.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/SM64%2FNSMB_(DS)_-_Bob-Omb_Squad_in_Negative_Harmony;;;This is an arrangement of "Negative Harmony Cover - Toxic" by Steve Cruickshank (itself a negative harmony cover of "Toxic" by Britney Spears) in the style and instruments of both versions of "Bob-Omb Squad", with the vocals of the aforementioned cover added over.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Super_Mario_64_-_File_Select_but_you're_in_the_bathroom_at_a_party;;;The advertised track is arranged into and mashed up with "Fireflies" by Owl City, which is heavily muffled to match the rest of the edit. Sounds of a crowd cheering are interspersed throughout.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Mii_theme_but_it_gets_worse_the_longer_you_listen;;;"Mii Channel" is played normally except from 0:36 to 0:51, when it becomes an arrangement of "Never Gonna Give You Up".  
    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dire_Dire_Docks%2FJolly_Roger_Bay_but_you're_listening_to_it_while_Underwater;;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.   This is an arrangement of "Drowning" by A Boogie Wit Da Hoodie ft. Kodak Black in the style and instruments of "Dire, Dire Docks", with the advertised filters and sound effects that emulate listening to the song underwater applied to it. The background melody is also arranged to "Among Us Trap Remix". At 0:57 and 2:10, the melody changes to an unknown song. At 2:29, the melody changes to another unknown song. Visually, the rip shows the Super Mario 64 logo tinted blue with footage of an ocean bed playing in the background. At 3:28, the video "Hello How Are You I Am Under the Water" by Just Sul plays faintly, with the video tinted blue to match the background, before the rip fades to black. The rip's description follows the writing conventions of (and was most likely written by) text-generating AI models such as ChatGPT, such as its overly upbeat nature and the way it often repeats the same point with slightly different wording.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Wind_Scene_from_Chrono_Trigger_but_it's_in_the_Super_Mario_64_Soundfont;;;The promised arrangement of "Wind Scene" using Super Mario 64 instruments is accompanied by a trap beat and voice clips from Super Mario 64.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Secret_course_-_super_mario_sunshine_(slowed_%2B_reverb);;;The advertised edit is applied to an arrangement of "Stand By Me" by Ben E. King in the style and instruments of "Secret Course", rather than the original "Secret Course". The rip also begins with the thumbnail image fading in from white, as in most Super Mario Sunshine rips. A GIF of falling rain is added over the darkened Super Mario Sunshine thumbnail.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Terraria_Rain_theme_but_its_all_sung_by_me;;;In addition to covering "Rain", the singer also raps the lyrics to "Hotel Breakfast" by Bladee, referencing various rips of Terraria that feature songs by Bladee as the joke of the rip. At 1:05, the singer abruptly starts repeating the generic voice lines from Mario Kart 8 online matches. This rip is inspired by "Terraria Underground theme but its all sung by me" by Osoch, which is linked in the description.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Stuck_Inside_but_in_the_Super_Mario_64_Soundfont;;;The rip begins as advertised, with an arrangement of "Stuck Inside" using instruments and voice clips from Super Mario 64. At 0:29, the part of the arrangement playing "Stuck Inside's" vocal melody changes to play the vocal melody of "GHOST" by nelward. At 1:28, "The Real Slim Shady" by Eminem is mashed up with the arrangement.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/FNAF_Circus_but_it_never_starts;;;The opening click from "Circus" is repeatedly played and mashed up with "HIT IT FOR ME (Vine Club Version)" by Sai Sen ft. ProGas. Starting at 0:05, Freddy's laugh is also arranged to the rip. The in-video thumbnail also uses the normal unedited Five Nights at Freddy's thumbnail.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Britney_Spears's_Lucky_in_the_SM64_soundfont;;;The rip begins as an arrangement of "Lucky" using Super Mario 64 instruments, as advertised. At 0:09, the melody changes to "Don't Tell Your WIFE About This Game!" by Brian David Gilbert. At 2:11, the vocals from "Don't Tell Your WIFE About This Game!" are added. In addition, the sentence "I've been failing my classes, but I don't give a damn." in the description is a reference to a lyric of "ANTONYMPH".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Michael_Jackson's_Smooth_Criminal_but_it's_Undertale;;;The thumbnail is taken from the in-video thumbnail from the rip "Billie Jean (OST Version) - Michael Jackson's Moonwalker". This is an arrangement of "Smooth Criminal" in the style and instrumentation of specifically "Mysterious Shrine" from Undertale, with elements of "Look At Me!" by XXXTENTACION mashed up and pitch-shifted starting at 0:25. At 1:02, the vocals mostly switch to "XXXTENTACION - "LOOK AT ME" MINECRAFT PARODY" by Galaxy Goats. At 1:18, a xylophone instrument is added, referencing the rip "Nintendo GameCube Startup - Console/BIOS Music". At 1:43, XXXTENTACION is sentence-mixed to sing "Smooth Criminal". At 1:46, "Guy Yelling Undertale Sound Effect" by minindo is pitch-shifted to the melody of "Nintendo GameCube Startup - Console/BIOS Music". At 1:50, the mashup briefly becomes bass-boosted.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Bonetrousle_but_every_other_beat_is_missing;;;"Bonetrousle" is arranged to "Shake it Off" by Taylor Swift, with the original vocals of "Shake it Off" played over it. As advertised, every other beat is removed. Additionally, the thumbnail is an edit of the Undertale logo reading "Tuned Earl". This is a reference to the common joke of making anagrams of the name, similar to how Deltarune is an anagram of Undertale.   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Stuck_Inside_but_it's_Sans_the_Skeleton's_Verse_(Megalovania);;;This is a parody of "stuck inside green skeleton verse" by @Bravvyy_2, which itself uses CG5's remix of "Stuck Inside" edited to reference Sans and "Megalovania". At 0:11, "EricBound" is shown and pitch-shifted to "Stuck Inside" in a YTPMV-esque style. At 0:29, the visuals zoom in on Ness's face and the word "Earthbound". At 0:30, the music video of "Stuck Inside" returns, but at 0:36, Freddy Fazbear is tinted blue and has one eye darkened to mimic Sans's glowing eye as "Megalovania" plays before the video abruptly ends. The switcheroo between Sans and a Ness-related source is a reference to Sans is Ness.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Sans_theme_but_you're_listening_to_it_in_the_back_seat_of_a_Tesla;;;In addition to the promised soundscape, the visuals also show the perspective of a person in the back seat of a Tesla parked in a field. A YTPMV of the "Hummer guy" scene from the Family Guy episode "Hell Comes to Quahog" set to "sans." is displayed on the Tesla's screen and playing faintly, with a border based on "Know Your Meme" reading "Family Guy Funny Moments". At 0:16, the visuals of the Tesla screen fade into this clip of real-life footage of a truck merging across several lanes while the driver listens to a mashup of "Hotline Bling" and "sans.".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Katy_Perry_-_Last_Friday_Night_(TGIF)_but_it's_in_Super_Mario_64's_Soundfont;;;Starting at 0:38, the melody occasionally changes to "No More Nuzzles", in reference to the rip "No More Nuzzles (In-Comic Version) - UNDERTALE: Halloween Hack". At 1:51, "BALDI'S BASICS THE MUSICAL" by LHUGUENY, which is based on "Last Friday Night (T.G.I.F.)", is pitch-shifted to and mashed up with the arrangement.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Sonic_3's_Flying_Battery_but_it%E2%80%99s_in_the_Super_Mario_64_Soundfont;;;"Mega Man" is pitch-shifted to and mashed up with the promised arrangement of "Flying Battery Zone (Act 1)" using instruments from Super Mario 64. Vocals from "Mega Man" are also looped and sampled in the arrangement in a manner that evokes Super Mario 64 instruments. From 0:13 to 0:23, the vocals of "Mega Man" are edited to sing "Good Morning, U.S.A.", the opening theme to American Dad!. "Yes Ma'am" by Jay Eazy is also briefly mashed up with the arrangement a few times, the first time being 0:17. From 0:26 to 0:40, "Mega Man"'s vocals are pitch-shifted to the melody of "Bad Romance", referencing both the rip "Flying Battery Zone (Act 2) (Beta Mix) - Sonic the Hedgehog 3 & Knuckles" and "story of mega man FULL VERSION (listen‼️)" by diaxart. The arrangement loops over at 0:40. At 1:24, the melody of the arrangement changes to "Meet the Flintstones" as it fades out.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Hill_Zone_but_it's_in_minor_key;;;This starts with the advertised conversion of "Green Hill Zone" to minor key, but then it becomes an arrangement of "STAY" in the style and instrumentation of "Green Hill Zone".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Damn_Daniel_ar_ar_ar_but_it's_Delfino_Plaza;;;The rip opens with the 'Damn Daniel' line from "Damn Daniel, Ar Ar Ar Ar Ar Ar Ar" played over the intro of "Delfino Plaza", setting up the advertised YTPMV. However, when the YTPMV actually begins, the original "Delfino Plaza" audio is no longer present and the 'ar ar ar ar' part is pitch-shifted to the first guitar chords from "Delfino Plaza" on loop for the whole duration of the rip (similarly to the rip "Delfino Plaza - Super Mario Sunshine"). At 2:05, clips of Luffy singing "Binks' Sake" from the Japanese version of the One Piece anime are added over the looping YTPMV unsynced, with the visuals from said scene faintly superimposed over the YTPMV visuals, likely playing off the Loud Nigra scream used in the aforementioned rip.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Live_%26_Learn_but_in_major_key;;;This is actually a major key conversion of the rip "Live & Learn - Sonic Adventure 2", rather than the original "Live & Learn". The video thumbnail is based off several uploads by Oleg Berg.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/NSMB_Overworld_theme_but_in_minor;;;This is an arrangement of "Stuck Inside" using the instruments and in the style of "Overworld Theme", playing off "Stuck Inside" being in a key of C minor, with vocals from "Stuck Inside" added as well. The video title is taken from the video "NSMB Overworld theme but in minor" by kuribo98. The thumbnail is based on the thumbnail from said video, but uses SiIvaGunner's New Super Mario Bros. thumbnail and has the color of the "New" starburst changed to green in reference to the rip's joke.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Buddy_Holly_by_Weezer_but_in_the_Mario_64_Soundfont;;;Instead of "Buddy Holly", this is an arrangement of "Say It Ain't So" by Weezer using the instruments from Super Mario 64.
