 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Theme_(Beta_Mix)_-_Undertale_2;;;This is a parody of the rip "Main Theme - Undertale 2". Much like the original, it references the "Baby I'm Yours" meme, in which a "bass-boosted" version of the song "Baby I'm Yours" by Breakbot ft. Irfane plays while something shocking happens. At the start, the rip displays the "SICK TRICKS WHITTY!" gif by L1meFish, which shows a ROBLOX Whitty model in a wheelchair attempting to do tricks in the game Robloxian High School with a caption on top reading "SICK TRICKS WHITTY!". The gif is accompanied by a version of "Baby I'm Yours" with Whitty's vocals in place of the originals. The gif plays once normally, then once in reverse. At 0:15, the gif becomes high contrast and starts playing at a fast speed without the reversal, and the audio becomes bass boosted. At 0:30, it switches to an image of the Nostalgia Critic, which zooms in and becomes stretched out and high contrast as the Undertale 2 logo appears at the bottom. At 0:31, the original "Baby I'm Yours" begins playing, also bass boosted.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/100_Sunny_(JP_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_OMORI;;;The rip begins by imitating "100 Sunny (JP Version) - OMORI", with the melody changed to "热爱105°C的你". At 0:25, the rip becomes an arrangement of "Sunshine, Rainbow, White Pony", with the original "Sunshine, Rainbow, White Pony" also sampled in the arrangement.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dinosaur2.wav_(Beta_Mix)_-_Portal;;;When run through slow-scan television decoder software, the rip produces the following image: The image is a reference to the original SSTV image found in "dinosaur2.wav - Portal". It contains the message "BETA MIX" encoded in hexahue. The text 6/19 from said rip is also present.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/What's_This!%3F_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_SilvaGu;;;A "C" chord is added to the track, making the melody resemble The Nutshack theme. The "Eugh!" from The Nutshack theme then plays over the final chord.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Mr._Patch_(PAL-M_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Banjo-Tooie;;;"I Like It" by Cardi B ft. Bad Bunny and J Balvin is mashed up and pitch-shifted with "Mr. Patch (PAL-M Version) - Banjo-Tooie".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dancing_Mad_(Alternate_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Final_Fantasy_VI;;;This is a parody of the rip "Dancing Mad (Alternate Version) - Final Fantasy VI". In this rip, the earlier rip's arrangement of "Soulless 4" by ExileLord is re-arranged to have the same structure as "Soulless 4 (Abridged) (Abridged)" by Hyperbolium, a parody of "Soulless 4".  The arrangement also contains the songs that are referenced in "Soulless 4 (Abridged) (Abridged)". The arrangement quotes "Through the Fire and Flames" by DragonForce from 4:56 to 5:00, "One" by Metallica from 10:12 to 10:27, and "Redbone" by Childish Gambino from 12:49 to 12:55.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Memories_(Beta_Mix)_-_Undertale;;;This rip deliberately uses the original title from the GiIvaSunner upload of "Memory - Undertale", titled "Memories - Undertale", to match with the joke's name. The thumbnail from said upload is also copied. This is an arrangement of "Memories" by Maroon 5. The arrangement starts out in the instrumentation of "Memory", but gradually transitions to elements from "Crank That", referencing the aforementioned rip.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Menu_(Strange_Things)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Toy_Story;;;This begins like the rip "Main Menu (Strange Things) - Toy Story", an arrangement of "Redial" from Bomberman Hero. However at 0:01, "Scatman's World" by Scatman John begins playing, with the rest of the rip having the main melody changed to "Scatman's World". At 2:02, Scatman John saying "BOP" plays. This references the rip "Radial (JP Version) - Bomberman Hero".     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/What's_This!%3F_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_SilvaGunner:_Ki;;;"Whopper Whopper" by Burger King is pitch-shifted to the advertised track. "fart with extra reverb" by DairyOrange is faintly synced to the final chord of the track.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Wanted!_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Super_Mario_64_DS;;;The rip begins with the "Yasss!" from "S.L.A.B. Freestyle", followed by "--bienvenidos a la cripta!" from "Dame Tu Cosita". The "Money Longer" melodyswap from "Wanted! (Beta Mix) - Super Mario 64 DS" is then mashed up with "S.L.A.B. Freestyle", which is edited so that Chip is sentence-mixed to "sing" "Dame Tu Cosita" and the drums match "Dame Tu Cosita"'s drum pattern. At 0:20, another brief sample from "Dame Tu Cosita" plays. The pairing of "Money Longer" and "Dame Tu Cosita" references the Dancing Alien Team.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Heal_(Alpha_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_OMORI;;;This uses the rip "Heal (Alpha Mix) - OMORI", which has the melody changed to the McDonald's "I'm lovin' it" jingle, with the "Cash Me Ousside / Howbow Dah" clip pitch-shifted to the melody changed and Flappy Bird sound effects pitch-shifted to the end notes of the aforementioned rip.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Simple_and_Clean_(Kappa_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Kingdom_Hearts:_Chain_of_Memories_II;;;At the start, a person does a low quality reading of the lyrics of the advertised track. At 0:20, the person switches into covering "The New Zelda Forest Temple Music" by Matt MVS. This references the rip "Simple and Clean (Kappa Mix) - Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories II" which also also a low quality cover with "Simple and Clean".     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Simple_and_Clean_(Sigma_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Kingdom_Hearts:_Chain_of_Memories_II;;;This is a low quality cover of the rip "Simple and Clean (Sigma Mix) - Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories II", which is an outtake of the rip "Simple and Clean (Kappa Mix) - Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories II".     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Aquatic_Ambience_(Beta_Mix)_-_SilvaGunner:_King_for_Another_Day;;;At 0:09, the rip slowly fades to black. It then plays the video "Fuck Love Perry" by Colaws, while the advertised track continues to play in the background. At 0:59, the rip transitions back to the thumbnail, with the King for Another Day logo changed to read "Fuck Love Country", and the advertised track is both melody-swapped and mashed up with "Fuck Love" by XXXTENTACION. At 2:20, an audio clip of the Phineas and Ferb episode "Perry Lays an Egg" is played. This references the rip "Aquatic Ambience (Alpha Mix) - Donkey Kong Country", with versions of the rip's jokes applied to the advertised track and its thumbnail instead of the original "Aquatic Ambience" and the Donkey Kong Country thumbnail.       A frame from the rip.   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Let_the_Game_Begin!_(Alpha_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Mario_Party_2;;;This is a version of "Let the Game Begin! (Alpha Mix) - Mario Party 2" with "Slider"'s leading melody changed to "Meet the Flintstones" and its countermelody left unchanged, referencing "Slider - Super Mario 64", a "Meet the Flintstones" melody-swap of "Slider" with the same structure.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Street_Fight_Area_01_(Beta_Mix)_-_Urban_Champion;;;At the beginning, the melody has been changed to "It Burns! Burns! Burns!". At 0:13, it changes to "Spooktune" from Undertale, but a portion of the track (0:13 - 0:14) loops over and over until 0:22, where the track resumes. The rip loops at 0:25 and 0:50 before fading out. This references the rip "Spooktune (Beta Mix) - Undertale", as the jokes are done in a similar manner as in this rip, and the rip "Street Fight Area 01 - Urban Champion", as that rip does a full "Spooktune" melody swap.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Vordhosbn_town_(Beta_Mix)_-_SilvaGunner:_King_for_Another_Day;;;The advertised track is mashed up with "Broken Eye Teeth" and "Suicide" by Xanopticon.  
https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Ending_Theme_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Pokémon_Red_%26_Blue;;;No joke found.
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Cram_It_Wad_(OST_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_OMORI;;;This is a version of "Cram It Wad (OST Version) - OMORI" with the melody changed to "Ultrasonic Sound" by Hive, the song that was replaced by "Talkin' Smack" (the joke in "Cram It Wad (OST Version)") in the 2006 rerelease of Pico's School.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Back_2_Back_(JP_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Sonic_Rush;;;This begins like the rip "Back 2 Back (JP Version) - Sonic Rush", with the advertised track mashed up with "Hit Me With Your Best Shot" by Pat Benatar at 0:19 and "Best Of You" by Foo Fighters at 0:43. However starting at 1:05, the rip loops the "the best" in "Best of You", referencing the video "THE BEST THE BEST THE BEST THE BEST THE BEST THE BEST THE BEST THE BEST" by THEBESTTHEBESTTHEBE. At 3:41, the "the best" lines are each pitch-shifted to a note of "Meet the Flintstones" before the rip abruptly ends.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/MeGaLoVania_(Beta_Mix)_-_Homestuck;;;This references the rip "MEGALOVANIA (Beta Mix) - Undertale". At 0:22, the melody changes to "Meet the Flintstones", in a manner that matches the aforementioned rip. At 0:55, the melody returns to normal, but without the guitar countermelody. The rip abruptly ends shorty after.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Waluigi_Pinball_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Mario_Kart_DS;;;At 0:07, the melody is partially changed to "Snow halation". It loops over at 0:49. This references the rip "Waluigi Pinball (Beta Mix) - Mario Kart DS", which uses another channel-signature meme ("Meet the Flintstones").     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Silence_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_F-Zero;;;The rip itself, as the title suggests, plays in complete silence, referencing the rip "Silence (Beta Mix) - F-Zero". However, instead of the thumbnail, the visuals are changed to a YTPMV-style video, set to the original unedited advertised track.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Slot_Machine_(Beta_Mix)_-_Super_3D_World;;;The rip itself plays the original "Slot Machine - Super 3D World", which recreates the original Yume Kōjō: Doki Doki Panic version of "Character Select" by removing the B-section of "Slot Machine". This references the audio quality of the version of "I Love Beijing Tiananmen" from Hong Kong 97, as well as its short loop.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/A_Leap_of_Faith_(Beta_Mix)_-_SilvaGunner:_Rebooted;;;The video begins much like the original "A Leap of Faith - SilvaGunner: Rebooted".  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Pigstep_(Unused)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Super_Smash_Bros._UItimate;;;The advertised track is mashed up with "THE PHOTOSYNTHESIS SONG" by Jam Campus, a parody of "Starboy" by The Weeknd ft.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/O_(Beta_Mix);;;No video titled "O" currently exists on the SiIvaGunner channel.[2] The title and this rip's thumbnail were instead briefly used for the rip "Main Theme - Vine" during its premiere. When Markiplier begins speaking, he is edited to loudly say "O", accompanied by Impact font text reading "O" at the top of the screen. The video then freezes on a frame of Markiplier laying on the bed with his eyes closed as everything around him fades to black and sad piano music starts playing. A continuous heart monitor beep then plays as the video ends with a complete fade to black.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Emote:_Sad_Trombone_(Beta_Mix)_-_Fortnite;;;This rip does not contain the advertised track.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/WINNER_(Round_1%2C_Match_6)_(Beta_Mix)_-_SiIvaGunner:_King_for_a_Day_Tournament;;;At 0:03, the video fades to white alongside with the video's audio. Afterwards, it fades in with "Can You Feel My Heart" by Bring Me The Horizon mashed up with "Harlem Shake". At 0:09, it fades in a recreation of the "Soyjaks vs. Chads" meme, but replacing the Soyjak and the Chad with Thanos and Ajit Pai respectively. The meme dialogue is shown, with Thanos' scrolling up due to its length and Ajit's simply shown on-screen. Ajit's text is "We are going to run this meme straight into the ground.", while Thanos' text is the following:  As a gamer and reviewer, I am absolutely livid at the decision to give Ajit Pai a channel takeover on SiIvaGunner before Thanos.It's completely and utter outrage that a politician who has done nothing but harm the internetand gaming community was given this opportunity over one of the most iconic villains in the Marvel Universe. Let's start with the obvious, Thanos is a gamer. He's played and conquered countless games across the universe.He's even gone so far as to create his own game, in the form of the Infinity Gauntlet, where he was able to manipulate reality itself.This is a level of gaming mastery that Ajit Pai could only dream of. Furthermore, Thanos embodies the spirit of gaming in a way that Ajit Pai never could. Gaming is all about overcomingchallenges and obstacles, and Thanos has done just that.He's faced off against some of the most powerful beings in the universe and come out on top.he's conquered entire civilizations and taken on entire armies single-handedly.This is the kind of gaming content that SiIvaGunner fans crave - epic, heroic battles that push the limits of what's possible. But it's not just Thanos' gaming skills that make him the obvious choice for a channel takeover. It's his personalityA complex, nuanced character with a deep sense of purpose and conviction. He has a clear goal in mind and will stop at nothing to achieve it.This level of dedication is something that the gaming community can truly appreciate. Compare that to Ajit Pai, who is nothing but a corporate shill with no regard for the interests of the gaming community.The guy who spearheaded the repeal of net neutrality, one of the most important protections for gamers and internet users in general.He's sold out to telecom companies and done everything in his power to make the internet a worse place for everyone. And yet, somehow, he was deemed worthy of a channel takeover onSiIvaGunner before Thanos? It's insulting, It's a slap in the face to gamers everywhere. I can't even imagine what kind of content Ajit Pai would create if given the opportunity to take over the SiIvaGunner channel.Probably some kind of cringe-inducing propaganda piece about how great the telecom companies areand how we should all be grateful for their benevolent leadership.Or maybe he'd just upload a video of himself counting all the money he's made by screwing over gamers and internet users. Meanwhile, Thanos would have brought a level of creativity and excitement to the channel that we haven't been before.He could have showcased some of his own gaming experiences, offered insights into the strategy behind his conquests,and even shared some of his favorite gaming moments with the SiIvaGunner community.  In conclusion, the decision to give Ajit Pai a channel takeover on SiIvaGunner before Thanos was a travesty.It's a missed opportunity to bring some truly epic gaming content to the channel, and a slap in the face to gamers everywhere.I hope that the SiIvaGunner team will see the error of their ways and give Thanos the chance to take over the channel that he so clearly deserves. At 0:13, a edited image of the GigaChad with the Reese's Puffs cup on his head appears, fading in the right screen. The description of the video is the same as the original video.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/The_Harlem_Shakeover_(Beta_Mix)_-_SiIvaGunner:_King_for_a_Day_Tournament;;;Much like the original "The Harlem Shakeover - SiIvaGunner: King for a Day Tournament", the rip begins with "Harlem Shake".  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Harlem_Shake_(Beta_Mix)_-_SilvaGunner:_King_for_Another_Day;;;At 0:14, the rip becomes an electronic forró-style arrangement of the advertised track using samples used by Os Barões da Pisadinha, with the "Harlem Shake" vocal samples from the track added on top.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/One_Fateful_Knight_(Beta_Mix)_-_Shovel_Knight;;;This uses the audio from the rip "One Fateful Knight - Shovel Knight", an arrangement of "INDUSTRY BABY" in the styles of various Shovel Knight tracks, although at a higher pitch. As a result, when a level gets popular, players will often visit and comment on the audio said level used.   2:32  Eversion  A GIF sequence of the "Mr. Incredible Becoming Uncanny" meme.  References the main mechanic of Eversion, which involves changing the current stage's state to a slightly different version of the stage, and this ability can be used recursively. Progressing through a level may require the player to go through multiple versions of the same level, each of which become more progressively gruesome and disturbing the deeper the player goes.   2:35  Iconoclasts fans when they see a pool of milk  This GIF of a woman jumping down the side of a cliff in heels.  References ivory, a white liquid that is an essential source of power in the Iconoclasts universe.   2:38  Pizza Tower fans visiting the grave of historic war hero William S. Notty  This GIF of a person breakdancing while putting a shirt on.  References Peppino's Breakdance mechanic in Pizza Tower and the mechanic of Snotty found within the tower.   2:40  Shmegdul Bobbin's Vacuuming Adventure fans when they finally beat Whirbert Hoover with no custom nozzles  A clip of Geometry Dash player npesta reacting to beating the custom level Kenos, originating from this YouTube video.  References the first slander joke in this rip (see 0:08 above).   2:43  Average Shovel Knight enjoyer  A GIF sequence of the "GigaChad" meme.  "X Slander" videos usually end with a "GigaChad" GIF captioned with "Average X Enjoyer", with the X being the title of a media the video creator likes.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/%E2%90%A3_(Beta_Mix);;;"Start of Yumenikki" from Yume Nikki, which was used as background music in the original "␣", is melody-swapped with "Lucid Dreamer". Immediately after the sequence, another follows, prefixed by "FIRST NAME" and flashing the characters "68 74 74 70 73 3a 2f 2f 69 2e 69 6d 67 75 72 2e 63 6f 6d 2f" rapidly. During both sequences, the screen mildly shakes and a slowed down version of the CrazyBus theme can be heard. After this, much like in the original, 123zc walks away from the camera, though the sunglasses stay place, as a "@GIIVASUNNER" icon appears onscreen. At 1:39, a picture of Shigeru Miyamoto appears, as "Ghostbusters" by Ray Parker Jr. begins playing, referencing the video "thats a no from me" by Dashunderscoredash.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Grass_Land_(NTSC_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Super_Mario_Bros._3;;;The melody begins to be changed to "Despacito", referencing the rip "Grass Land (NTSC Version) - Super Mario Bros. 3", but it quickly changes to "Dejala" by Duende and Flex. This references the rip "Let the Game Begin! (Beta Mix) - Mario Party 2", which had the same jokes with a similar structure.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Bowser's_Theme_(OST_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Super_Mario_64;;;The rip is an edit of "So Yeah You're Gay (GTA Guitar Bro)" by Dustmask Bandit, a video of an Xbox 360 voice message in which a conceited player berates the message recipient before poorly playing the riff from Metallica's "Enter Sandman" on an electric guitar. The last line of dialogue is edited with Mario's "gay Bowser!" voice clip and the guitar solo is changed to an arrangement of "Enter Sandman" using the lead instrument of the advertised track, though with several notes timed incorrectly to match the performance in the video. The rip is a reference to the original "Bowser's Theme (OST Version) - Super Mario 64", which uses an full arrangement of "Enter Sandman".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dinosaur18.wav_(Beta_Mix)_-_Portal;;;When run through slow-scan television decoder software, the rip produces the following image: The image is a variation of the "My Brother in Christ" meme. Decoding the hexadecimal within the text and stringing it together yields the message "YOU JUST LOST THE GAME". This references the rip "dinosaur18.wav - Portal", which features a image based on another fast food restaurant.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Babs_Seed_(Beta_Mix)_-_My_Little_Pony:_Friendship_Is_Magic;;;The rip starts out by recreating the rip "Babs Seed - My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic", a mashup of the advertised track's instrumental and the vocals to "When Can I See You Again?" by Owl City, but at 0:07, "When Can I See You Again?" is swapped out with the vocals to "How Do I Craft This Again?" by Yogscast, a Minecraft-themed parody of "When Can I See You Again?".     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dogsong_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Undertale;;;The rip begins much like "Dogsong (Beta Mix) - Undertale", where at 0:08, the rip turns into a recreation of "At Doom's Gate" from Doom using the Dog and Mario instruments from Mario Paint that are used in the advertised track. However starting at 0:16, the rest of the rip loops the beginning section of the arrangement until 3:31, where it changes to a MIDI of the theme song from the show Drake & Josh. This references the rip "Hangar - Doom" which follows a structure and jokes similar to this rip.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Snowdin_Town_(Kicked_In_the_Dick_Remix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Undertale;;;This is an arrangement of the rip "Snowdin Town (Kicked In the Dick Remix) - Undertale" (a "Meet the Flintstones" melody-swap of "Undertale OST - Snowdin Town (Kicked In the Dick Remix)" by Elu Tran) in the style of "Meatball Parade" by Kevin MacLeod.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Snowdin_Town_(Beta_Mix)_(Kicked_In_the_Dick_Remix)_-_Undertale;;;This plays "Undertale OST - Snowdin Town (Kicked In the Dick Remix)" by Elu Tran, where he fulfilled someone's (joke) request to loop the first five notes of the advertised track for 15 minutes, with it mashed up with The Nutshack theme, with it pitch-shifted to the advertised track. At 14:50, it plays the rest of the mashup. At 14:58, "Fuck tha Police" by N.W.A is briefly added to the rip before it abruptly ends, referencing the rip "Snowdin Town (Beta Mix) - Undertale".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Robots_FTW_(Beta_Mix)_-_SilvaGunner:_King_for_Another_Day;;;The melody has been changed to "Gadget Room". Starting at 0:52, it changes to various melodies.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Explosion_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Mario_Paint;;;The track plays normally until the final note, which becomes a Mario Paint Composer arrangement of "Fall 'n' Roll" from Fall Guys. At 0:37, the rip abruptly ends. This is a reference to the rip "Explosion - Mario Paint", which features a similar joke. As well as that, this rip follows the same structure as the aforementioned rip, including the abrupt ending.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Mammory_Master_(Beta_Mix)_-_Vast_Error;;;This is an arrangement of "Emote: Dance Moves" from Fortnite, using the instruments and style of the advertised track.   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/There's_nothing_happening_(Beta_Mix);;;No video titled "There's nothing happening" currently exists on the SiIvaGunner channel. The title and this rip's thumbnail were instead briefly used for the livestream "h (Beta Mix)" during its duration. The rip is centered on the January 21, 2003 Garfield comic strip, which is the main subject and joke of the subreddit r/AlzheimersGroup, where the strip is frequently posted and referenced by users pretending to have Alzheimer's disease. Two text-to-speech voices recite the text of the strip until the voice that recites Jon Arbuckle's line goes on a long tangent about The Game seemingly sourced from ChatGPT. From 0:26 to 0:52, audio of Splatoon player putz12 raging plays in the background.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/A_Video_Based_On_Your_Defeat_(Beta_Mix);;;The audio from the original video is mashed up and pitch-shifted to "BIG SHOT" from Deltarune. At the beginning, the battle start sound effect from Deltarune plays. In the parts where the right side of the screen is entirely green, the left side is mirrored and green-screened onto it. Starting at 0:13, purple and yellow transparent copies of the singer are added beside him, referencing the colors of Spamton's glasses, and the background from Spamton NEO's regular boss fight is edited behind the singer.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Title_Theme_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_SkiFree_2;;;This rip is a reference to the rip "Title Theme - SkiFree 2".  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Company_Logos_(Beta_Mix)_-_Banjo-Kazooie;;;The rip begins identically to "Company Logos - Banjo-Kazooie", as an arrangement of "Carnival Night Zone (Act 1)" from Sonic the Hedgehog 3 & Knuckles.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Three_Minutes_Clapping_(Beta_Mix)_-_The_World_Ends_with_You;;;This is a recreation of the rip "Three Minutes Clapping - The World Ends with You" using "S.L.A.B.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Narrow_Road_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Falsion;;;This begins like the rip "Narrow Road (Beta Mix) - Falsion", with a black screen as the opening of "S.L.A.B. Freestyle" plays. At 0:02, the advertised track plays, as it switches to a offbeat and offkey mashup with "Astronaut in the Ocean", which has been bitcrushed. Additionally, the advertised track is edited such that all sound channels also fall out of sync with each other. At 1:47, a King for Another Day reveal happens, which changes to the TikTok "Among us #fyp #foryou #walmart #amongus #sus" by @david.rieman. At 1:56, it shows a fake character reveal for "Orange Crewmate".  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/A_Certain_Someone's_Memories_(PAL_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_MOTHER_3;;;At 0:22, the melody changes to the My Little Pony: Meet the Ponies theme song, referencing how the rip "A Certain Someone's Memories (PAL Version) - MOTHER 3" had a melody swap with the My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic theme song.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/My_Sweet_Passion_(OST_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Sonic_Adventure;;;This combines the rips "My Sweet Passion - Sonic Adventure" and "My Sweet Passion (OST Version) - Sonic Adventure". In this rip, the latter rip's vocals are covered in the same manner as the former rip. At 1:53, after the "I had to shave it" section of "My Sweet Passion (OST Version)", the music stops and the ripper says "Okay so, I have just returned from the depths of hell to go shave a Pershian cat. Or, was it a sphinx that I shaved? Well, whatever it was that I shaved it was so worth it. Now, back to the song. Where were we?". At 2:10, the music returns and the cover continues. At 3:06, most of the lyrics of the final section of "My Sweet Passion (OST Version)" are replaced with dialogue about why a line is changed:   Walnuts, peanuts, pineapple smells  Grapes, melons, oranges, and Coco Pommel! Ah yeah! I know it's not the right character but come on Coco Pommel fits great and, and rhymes with pineapple smells, Whereas Amy Rose does not rhyme with pineapple smells so shut up, just let me have this okay. This is over anyway, this cover is over.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Bb_(beta_mix);;;This is an arrangement of "Lucid Dreamer" in the style and instruments of the advertised track. At the end, the track is melody-swapped with "Lucid Dreams" and mashed up with "XO Tour Llif3" by Lil Uzi Vert, referencing the rips "Lucid Dreamer - Touhou 16.5: Violet Detector" and "Lucid Dreamer (Alternate Version) - Touhou 16.5: Violet Detector" respectively.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dr._Mario_(OST_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Super_Smash_Bros._Melee;;;The rip starts similarly to "Dr. Mario (OST Version) - Super Smash Bros. Melee", with "Crank That" by Soulja Boy being mashed up with the advertised track, and audio from "PERC 30 DISASTER!!!" by Ghetto Smosh playing at 0:06. However, at 0:08, the "Crank That" vocals are replaced with pitch-shifted vocals from "Phonics Song" by Gracie's Corner. Additionally, this stock "Huh?" sound is also played at various points throughout the rip. At 0:30, 0:48, 1:34 and 1:54, "Harlem Shake" is briefly pitch-shifted to the advertised track. From 0:50 to 1:00 and 1:54 to 2:04, "Meet the Flintstones" is played using "Crank That"'s steel drums, referencing the rip "Dr. Mario - Super Smash Bros. Melee". At 1:30, the word "Apple" in "Phonics Song" is replaced with the same word from "PPAP".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/%3F%3F%3F_(Beta_Mix);;;No video titled "???" currently exists on the SiIvaGunner channel. The title and this rip's thumbnail were instead used for the rip "Route 228 (Day & Night) (DS Sounds) - Pokémon Brilliant Diamond & Shining Pearl" before its premiere. This plays a deliberately bad recording of the unique section of the original rip. At 0:49, a phone rings on vibrate over the rip, followed by the microphone recording the rip colliding with something or being dropped. At 1:13, the rip comes to a stop, but the microphone continues recording. At 1:16, a person starts loudly snoring right before the rip abruptly ends. This references the rip "Ruins - Undertale", which had a similar joke and ending.  
https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/420AnnounceIt_(Beta_Mix);;;No joke found.
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Main_Theme_(Beta_Mix)_-_e;;;The rip is a parody of "Main Theme - e". The rip begins identically to "Main Theme - e", but at 0:02, "Smooth" cuts off without the "e" sounds, and the "e"s in the edited WarioWare: Smooth Moves thumbnail disappear. At 0:21, the part of "Smooth" where Rob Thomas says "seven" plays, in the same manner as the "e" sounds in the original rip. At 0:35, the rip becomes a mashup of "Smooth"'s instrumental with audio from the Numberphile video "Why 7 is Weird", which is pitch-shifted to "Smooth"'s vocal melody, and the "e"s in the image are replaced with 7s based on the 7 GRAND DAD title screen.       The static image displayed in the rip at 0:02.        The static image displayed in the rip at 0:35.   The video description, including the link to the Numberphile channel's "James Grime on Numberphile" playlist, is copied directly from the rip it parodies, save for the addition of the rip's mix name.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Harlequin_(Alpha_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Homestuck;;;This is an arrangement of "Playing Forever" from OMORI in the instruments and style of the advertised track, with the rip arranged to be in 4/4 time signature as well. This is a reference to "Harlequin (Alpha Mix) - Homestuck" and "Harlequin (Beta Mix) - Homestuck", the former also being an arrangement of "Playing Forever" and the latter also being an arrangement in the 4/4 time signature.  
https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/GiIva_Direct:_The_High_Quality_Bubsy_Rip_(Beta_Mix);;;No joke found.
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Happier%2C_Better%2C_Faster%2C_Stronger_(Beta_Mix)_-_SiIvaGunner:_King_for_Another_Day_Tournament;;;The rip begins in the same way as the original reveal trailer. However, after Daft Punk uncovers the SiIvaGunner invite envelope, they slowly cover it back up with snow and walk away. The team name and character art card are replaced with a caption reading "they didn't wanna be in the tournament :(" We then see a short clip of Thomas Bangalter from Daft Punk exploding, from their 2006 short film "Electroma".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Sweet_Sweet_Canyon_(Beta_Mix)_-_Mario_Kart_8_Deluxe;;;At 0:03, the visual becomes a slideshow of various cat-related images set to the music's beat, referencing the rip "Sweet Sweet Canyon - Mario Kart 8 Deluxe", which features a similar slideshow of dog-related images. The slideshow begins with a picture of a kitty later known on the channel as Brainless Kitty. At 0:10, 0:50, and 0:51, pictures of fennec foxes appear. At 0:15, "I watched the first episode of Chi's Sweet home" by KasaiNeko42a appears, with several words blocked out to make the text "I'M LOST AND HUNGRY/AND ****** CRYING ******* *** *****". At 0:16 and 0:49, pictures of Sakamoto from Nichijou appear. At 0:26, a picture of the "Cat" music disc from Minecraft appears. At 0:57, a picture of Walter Jr. from Breaking Bad briefly appears, referencing the line "You're a pussy!" from the episode "Gray Matter". This picture is quickly overtaken by the Brainless Kitty picture zooming in, after which all subsequent cat pictures are of the exotic shorthair breed with faces similar to Brainless Kitty's. At 1:51, the picture used in the "Darren and Sharron" meme briefly appears. At 1:52, the "EHHH EH EH EH" TikTok by @sp3_clan_sg is pitch-shifted to the advertised track, while the logo is changed to read "JUMLAND 8 Deluxe".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Staff_Roll_(Beta_Mix)_-_Super_M%CC%B8%CC%8C%CC%8Aa%CC%B4%CD%9B%CC%BF%E2%96%88%CC%B8%CD%8C%CC%91i%CC%B5%CC%9B%CD%8A%E2%96%88%CC%B7%CC%BE%CC%93_64;;;This is a parody of @pensivemoji's YandereDev version of "I Used To Roll The Dice", a sentence-mixed edit of "Viva La Vida". The rip uses an edited version of "Staff Roll - Super M̸̌̊a̴͛̿█̸͌̑i̵̛͊█̷̾̓ 64", an arrangement of "Viva La Vida", with the melody edited to match the sentence-mixed lyrics in "I Used To Roll The Dice". In addition, like the original video, the rip features a slideshow of images with Impact text transcribing the lyrics; instead of YandereDev pictures, however, the rip uses pictures of Mario, as well as a screenshot of the Nintendo.com article "Super Mario 3D All-Stars leaves Nintendo eShop on March 31st." at 0:08, referencing the theme of the April Fools' Day 2021 event, a Super Mario Galaxy "Too bad!" screen at 0:42, and the teaser poster for the The Super Mario Bros. Movie at 0:55.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Enemy_Approaching_(Alpha_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Undertale;;;This is an arrangement of "Bad Apple!!" from Touhou 4: Lotus Land Story with elements of "Bad Apple!! feat.nomico" by Alstroemeria Records, referencing "Enemy Approaching (Alpha Mix) - Undertale". The arrangement begins in the instruments and style of "Anticipation" from Undertale. At 0:08, the thumbnail fades into the video "it's all connected" by baraGodzilla, as the instruments from each respective Undertale song featured in the video (namely "Anticipation", "Enemy Approaching", "Dogsong", and "Tem Shop") are added to the arrangement in sync with the video. At 1:02, the arrangement ends with a fragment of the original "Enemy Approaching".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Dear_(Siiva_Swim)_(Beta_Mix)_SiIva_Swim;;;Instead of stating that the lack of Undertale rips is due to rips taking time to make followed by an unrelated tangent, the bumper now claims that it's due to the fact the creatives of Siiva Swim hate Undertale, Toby Fox, and the fans. The melody of the "Megalovania" arrangement has also been changed to "No More Nuzzles".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Run_(OST_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Hotline_Miami_2:_Wrong_Number;;;At 0:20, "Damn Daniel! [Trap Remix]" by Dennibro and FlightReacts saying "Damn Daniel, ar ar ar ar ar ar ar" are pitch-shifted to the melody. At 0:39, the "Wow!" sound effect from Fairy Tail plays. At 0:42, a clip of FlightReacts screaming can be heard. This references the rip "Run (OST Version) - Hotline Miami 2: Wrong Number", due to sources being used in a similar manner as in the aforementioned rip.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Rhythm_Toys_(Beta_Mix)_-_SilvaGunner:_King_for_Another_Day;;;The melody and backing chords of the original arrangement are changed to "Game with Rabbit" from Othello World. At 0:24, the lyrics "do the stanky legg" from "Stanky Legg" by GS Boys are pitch-shifted to the tune of the arrangement, and the thumbnail of the video flips back and forth to the music, similarly to "Groose's Theme - The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword". At 0:48, "The Fall of Jake Paul" by Logan Paul is mashed up with the advertised track, and the music video plays in the center of the screen.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/American_Boy_(Beta_Mix)_-_DJ_Hero_2;;;This is a parody of the rip "American Boy - DJ Hero 2". Like the original rip, this is mostly a mashup of the original version of "American Boy" that the advertised track is a remix of and the instrumental to "Seeya" by deadmau5 ft. Colleen D'Agostino. In this rip however, the vocals of "American Boy" are replaced with the vocals of "Party Time" by The Northern Boys, a song that samples "American Boy". At 2:08, the lyric "granddad" is replaced with an equivalent clip from Vinesauce Joel's reaction to 7 GRAND DAD.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Invincibility_(Beta_Mix)_-_Kirby:_Squeak_Squad;;;Elements of "Goofy Ahh Phonk (Bababooey type beat)" by Memnicus are pitch-shifted and arranged to the rip "Invincibility - Kirby: Squeak Squad". At 0:21, the sample of "Main Theme" from Bad Piggies featured in "Goofy Ahh Phonk (Bababooey type beat)" is also arranged to the aforementioned rip.  The rip loops at 0:42 before fading out.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/The_Star_of_the_Underground_(Beta_Mix)_-_Underveil;;;At 1:34, the advertised track is mashed up the Poopsie Surprise Slime spoof of "My Humps" by The Black Eyed Peas, referencing the rip "The Star of the Underground - Underveil".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Environmental_Noises_(Beta_Mix)_-_Super_Smash_Bros._Brawl;;;The rip initially plays the video seen in the removed rip "Environmental Noises - Super Smash Bros. Brawl", but instead of the pigeon being punched, a disembodied hand appears and caresses it, accompanied by an "Aww!" sound effect. The clip is repeated in slow motion, like the original rip, then zooms in on a still frame as "We Are the Champions (Ding a Dang Dong)" by Crazy Frog starts playing, replacing "We Are the Champions" by Queen from the original rip, and red text reading "LOVE YOU / FUNNY BIRD" scrolls upwards. At 0:11, "Bird Up!" is pitch-shifted to "We Are the Champions (Ding a Dang Dong)". The video description of this rip also mimics that of the aforementioned rip, with the inaccurate platform section (compared to GilvaSunner's uploads, which used "Game: Super Smash Bros. Brawl"), the lyrics of "We Are the Champions" replaced with those of "We Are the Champions (Ding a Dang Dong)", as well as them being the ones that play in the rip itself, and the catchphrase used by The Voice Inside Your Head.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Seascape_(Beta_Mix)_-_Knuckles'_Chaotix;;;The melody has been changed to "GHOST" by nelward. This references the rip "Seascape - Knuckles' Chaotix" as "Just the Two of Us" by Grover Washington Jr. and Bill Withers, the joke of the aforementioned rip, and "GHOST" share the same chords.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Phineas_and_Ferb_Takeover_Reveal_(Beta_Mix)_SiIvaFes;;;At 0:06, when Isabella shows the video of Phineas on her computer, Phineas is sentence-mixed to say "Fuck love, Perry the platypus! Fuck love", referencing the rip "Aquatic Ambience (Alpha Mix) - Donkey Kong Country". Candace then screams and the video ends. The video description of this rip is almost directly copied from the original "Phineas and Ferb Takeover Reveal || SiIvaFes". The only differences are that the rip's mix name is added to the title and music lines in the email submission format.

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Emote:_Zany_(OST_Version)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Fortnite_Chapter_2;;;This is an arrangement of "David S. Pumpkins" using the instruments of the advertised track.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/What's_This!%3F_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_SilvaGunner:_King_for_Another_Day;;;The melody has been changed to "Meet the Flintstones".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Simple_and_Clean_(Pi_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Kingdom_Hearts:_Chain_of_Memories_II;;;The rip initially consists of the ripper crudely singing the digits of e to the melody of "Simple and Clean" with heavy reverb applied. At 0:23, the ripper stops singing and says the following:  I don't know, I'm not that familiar with "Simple and Clean" as a song. This is as far as I'll go with the digits of the big famous constant e. This is a reference to the rip "Simple and Clean (Pi Mix) - Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories II", which was a crude cover consisting of the digits of pi. This rip's abnormal video description catchphrase and the last sentence spoken by the ripper reference the Numberphile video "e (Euler's Number)".  
    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Megalovania_(Beta_Mix)_-_Kingdom_Hearts:_Chain_of_Memories_II;;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.Missing: Not sure if the instruments are specifically from anywhere.   This is a deliberately cacophonous arrangement of "Megalovania" using various chime instruments. At 0:33, the instruments are arranged to "Mukidashi de Mukiatte" by Morning Musume '16. Like most rips in this playlist, the music is heavily reverbed, making it even more cacophonous. This is a reference to "Megalovania - Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories II", which also features a deliberately cacophonous and heavily reverbed "Megalovania".     
    https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Master_of_Masters_(Beta_Mix)_-_Kingdom_Hearts:_Chain_of_Memories_II;;;The Joke-Explainer™ 7000 needs your help!  This joke list is incomplete! Please listen to the rip and help fill out these pesky missing spaces.   At the start, it plays a more reverbed version of the rip "Master of Masters - Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories II". At 0:20, it plays a heavily reverbed version of "Plant" from Cave Story with the melody changed to an unknown song.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Kahootris_(Beta_Mix)_-_Kingdom_Hearts:_Chain_of_Memories_II;;;This begins with an arrangement of "Raining Tacos" by Parry Gripp (recreated using the vocals of "Raining Tacos" and the instruments of "Defense Battle 1" from Tetris 99). From 0:01 to 3:00, a heavily distorted and sped up version of "Lobby" from Kahoot! plays over the arrangement. This is a reference to "Kahootris - Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories II", which is also an unsynced mashup that features "Defense Battle 1" and "Lobby".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Bramble_Blast_(Beta_Mix)_-_Super_Smash_Bros._Brawl;;;At 0:12, the advertised track is mashed up with the rip "Blammed (Week 4 Update) - Friday Night Funkin'", a mashup and melody-swap with "Trap Queen" by Fetty Wap. This is a reference to the rip "Bramble Blast - Super Smash Bros. Brawl", which is a mashup with "Trap Queen" and is itself referenced in the visuals of "Blammed (Week 4 Update) - Friday Night Funkin'".     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Yoshi's_Tropical_Island_(Beta_Mix)_-_Mario_Party;;;The melody initially changes to "Take On Me", then to "Snow halation" at 0:10. At 0:45, during "Snow halation"'s chorus, the melody of the chorus of "Take On Me" is played at the same time. The melody then briefly changes to "Canon in D" by Johann Pachelbel before the rip loops over and fades out. This is not only a reference to the rip "Yoshi's Tropical Island - Mario Party", which features "Take On Me", but also "Yogurt Yard (Alternate Mix) - Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land", which features the same jokes with similar execution. The Voice Inside Your Head's catchphrase from the original "Yoshi's Tropical Island - Mario Party" is also included in this rip's video description.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/A_CERTIFIED_HOOD_ANNOUNCEMENT_(Beta_Mix);;;No elements of the original announcement is featured in the rip. This is an edited version of an infamous Super Mario Bros. GIF animation set to the first five notes of "Crank Dat Super Mario". The small Mario is changed to resemble Gangsta Mario, while a sprite of a marijuana leaf replaces the Super Mushroom. The video description of this rip is also directly copied from the original "A CERTIFIED HOOD ANNOUNCEMENT".      The GIF featured in the rip.   
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Anouncement.wmv_(Beta_Mix);;;The video begins like the original "anouncement.wmv", with it seeming to suggest how to download the album. However at 0:07, it switches to showing sped up gameplay of Fall Guys, which ends with the person recording losing on the last round.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Intro_Theme_(Beta_Mix)_(Beta_Mix)_-_Mundial_Ronaldinho_Soccer_64;;;At the beginning, the melody is changed to "Main Menu/Map" from Hotel Mario as the advertised game's intro plays.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/SiIvaGunner_YouTube_Trailer_(Beta_Mix);;;This is a highly compressed and edited version of Channel Awesome's "Channel Awesome YouTube Trailer" in which several words and phrases are replaced with an audio clip of the Nostalgia Critic saying "I love whores" from "Captain N Cartoon - Nostalgia Critic". At 0:45, the website at the bottom is changed to "ilovewhores.com", and the clips of other Channel Awesome reviewers have a pink heart-filled filter applied. At 1:01, the Drama Alert intro plays and transitions into the original "Captain N Cartoon - Nostalgia Critic" clip, which is slowed down and abruptly cut off before the Nostalgia Critic says "I love whores". The video description of this rip is also directly copied from the original "SiIvaGunner YouTube Trailer".

 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/The_Party_Begins..._(Beta_Mix);;;Instead of having Wood Man appear at 0:04, the video remains on the initial gray screen with no audio except for faint ambient feedback, with the gray slightly changing in color and the audio's volume being slightly changed at several points.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Prologue_(Beta_Mix)_-_The_SiIvaGunner_Christmas_Comeback_Crisis;;;The rip initially plays the original "Prologue", with The Voice Inside Your Head entering SiIvaGunner's home at night.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Pasteurised_Plains_(Beta_Mix);;;The advertised track becomes an arrangement of "Take On Me" during the fadeout, referencing "Yogurt Yard - Kirby: Nightmare in Dream Land"; in this rip, the "Take On Me" arrangement starts at 0:13 and is extended to the rest of the arrangement.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Intro_(Beta_Mix)_-_SilvaGunner:_Rebooted;;;This is an edited version of the pre-Photoshop Flowey opening sequence from Undertale parodying the events of the original "Intro - SilvaGunner: Rebooted".  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Following_Stanley_(Beta_Mix)_-_The_Stanley_Parable;;;At 0:03, voice clips of the Rabbids are arranged and pitch-shifted to the advertised track.  https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Timed_Trial_(Beta_Mix)_-_Fortnite;;;The melody has been changed to "Satellite Scramble" from Fall Guys. This is a reference to "Timed Trial - Fortnite", which uses a different track from Fall Guys as its joke.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Awakening_(Beta_Mix)_-_Final_Fantasy_VI;;;This rip is based on "Awakening - Final Fantasy VI", where the melody changes to "Free Flight" from Ginga Force. However, the melody wasn't known to be "Free Flight" at the time of this rip's creation, so all elements of "Free Flight" present in this rip are based entirely on "Awakening - Final Fantasy VI", and aren't accurate to the original "Free Flight". At 0:12, the melody begins to change to "Free Flight" as in the aforementioned rip, but almost immediately the chords switch to those of "Subways Of Your Mind", with the melody being altered to match. At 0:25, the melody fully changes to that of "Subways Of Your Mind". At 0:51, it changes back to "Free Flight". The rip loops over at 1:04. The use of "Subways Of Your Mind" is meant to draw a parallel to the unidentified nature of both it and "Free Flight" at the time, though, ironically, "Free Flight" would be discovered only two weeks after this rip's upload. The title of the album release references this mishap.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Paper_Planes_(Beta_Mix)_-_Far_Cry_3;;;This rip uses "Banos" by StreetmanTV, a parody of the advertised track, which features its instrumental. "Banos" is mashed up with "Wii Shop Channel" at 0:11, an arrangement of "Meet the Flintstones" using the instruments of "Tem Shop" from Undertale at 0:22, an arrangement of "Witch Doctor" by Cartoons using the lead instrument from "Overworld Theme" from Super Mario World at 0:33, and an arrangement of "Fuck You" by CeeLo Green using the lead instrument from "Green Greens" from Kirby's Dream Land at 0:43. The rip slows down to a halt at 0:56. The rip as a whole references "Paper Planes - Far Cry 3". In addition, the three arrangements each reference other rips: "Meet the Flintstones" with "Tem Shop" references "Tem Shop - Undertale", "Witch Doctor" with "Overworld Theme" references "Athletic Theme (PAL Version) - Super Mario World", and "Fuck You" with "Green Greens" references "Traveling the Woods - Kirby: Squeak Squad".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Super_Mario_All-Stars_Music_-_SMB_Lost_Levels_Invincible_(Beta_Mix);;;This is an arrangement of "I Just Had Sex" by The Lonely Island ft. Akon using the instruments of the advertised track. Starting at 0:33, AI-generated vocals in the voice of Pinkie Pie sing the lyrics to "I Just Had Sex", referencing the video "pinkie just had sex!!!!!!!!!!" by theburninice1. At 0:45 and 1:31, the melody briefly changes to "Pinkie Pie's Singing Telegram" from the My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic episode "Party of One". This is a reference to the rip "Super Mario All-Stars Music - SMB Lost Levels Invincible", which referenced both "Pinkie Pie's Singing Telegram" and "pinkie just had sex!!!!!!!!!!" in different ways.     
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Sunken_Seacrets_(Beta_Mix)_-_Fall_Guys;;;At 0:03 and 1:41, the advertised track is mashed up with "SICKO MODE". At 0:40 and 2:01, "Yankin" is mashed up with the advertised track. At 1:01 and 2:21, instruments from "MEGALOVANIA" are arranged to the advertised track. This references the rip "Sunken Seacrets - Fall Guys" which used similar sources at the corresponding times.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/RAT's_Dream_(Beta_Mix)_-_Mad_Rat_Dead;;;The rip opens as an arrangement of the advertised track in the style of "Megalo Strike Back" from I Miss You - EarthBound 2012. At 0:13, the arrangement's melody changes to "PLAY DICE!" by Hakos Baelz. This rip combines both jokes of the rips "RAT's Dream - Mad Rat Dead" and "MAD HEART (Alpha Mix) - Mad Rat Dead", with the former rip being an arrangement of the advertised track using instruments of "Megalo Strike Back", and the latter rip featuring "PLAY DICE!".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Fun_Park_Massive_(Beta_Mix)_-_No_One_Can_Stop_Mr._Domino!;;;The advertised track is mashed up with "Space Jam". At 0:15 the advertised track is mashed up with "Stadium Rave A" from SpongeBob SquarePants production music library. At 0:21, loud, bass-boosted clips of both "U Guessed It" by OG Maco and "No Words" by Hopsin, both of the songs associated with Green de la Bean, are briefly played, referencing the removed rip "Fun Park Massive - No One Can Stop Mr. Domino!" which plays said songs at identical timestamp. At 1:04, realistic stereo knocking noises are added to the rip, referencing the removed rip "Peach Beach & Daisy Cruiser - Mario Kart: Double Dash!!".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Hangar_(Beta_Mix)_-_Doom;;;The opening is extended to loop until 0:52, when the track seemingly resumes. At 1:00, the guitar section is extended with random notes that randomly increase or decrease in pitch until 3:03, where the last note is held until 3:08, before continuing the section with more random notes that decrease in pitch. At 3:11, the rip plays an arrangement of "Road To Riches" by Yuno Miles using the instruments of the advertised track, with the vocals mashed up with the arrangement. This references the rip "Hangar - Doom", which features the same opening loop and similarly ends with a different song in the advertised track's instruments.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Zelda's_Theme_(Beta_Mix)_-_The_Legend_of_Zelda:_Majora's_Mask;;;"Bonfire" is pitch-shifted and mashed up with the advertised track. At 0:42, "V. 3005" by Childish Gambino is also mashed up with the advertised track. At 1:25, audio from "Derrick: Wink" by CollegeHumor is added to the rip.  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/Violet_Sky_-_Hotel_Dusk:_Room_215;;;At 0:11 and 0:50, the melody changes to "Snow halation". At 0:33, it changes to "Meet the Flintstones". At 0:54, it changes to "Hate not the Wind, Spring Blossoms ~ Eternal Wind".  
 https://siivagunner.fandom.com/wiki/No_More_What_Ifs_-_Persona_5_Royal;;;The advertised track is mashed up with "Lovers Rock" by Sade.
